# Creating Variables

## VDEM

```{r echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
vdem <- vdem_raw %>%
  filter(year >= 1970) %>%
  transmute(
    country                       = country_name,
    region                        = e_regiongeo,
    year                          = year,
    edi                           = v2x_polyarchy,
    inflation                     = e_miinflat,
    inflation_lagged              = lag(e_miinflat, 1),
    cso_repression                = v2csreprss,
    cso_female_participation      = v2csgender,
    cso_anti_system               = v2csantimv,
    media_censor_effort           = v2mecenefm,
    internet_censor_effort        = v2mecenefi,
    power_by_gender               = v2pepwrgen,
    regimes_of_world              = v2x_regime,
    exclusion_gender              = v2xpe_exlgender,
    women_political_empowerment   = v2x_gender,
    false_info_gov                = v2smpardom,
    block_content_internet        = v2smgovfilprc,
    internet_shut_down            = v2smgovshut,
    social_media_shut_down        = v2smgovsm,
    gdp_capita                    = e_gdppc,
    gdp_capita_lagged             = lag(e_gdppc, 1),
    gdp                           = e_gdp,
    gdp_lagged                    = lag(e_gdp, 1),
    population                    = e_pop
  )
```

### VDEM name harmonisation

```{r}
vdem <- vdem %>%
  mutate(country = case_match(
    country,
    "Türkiye"             ~ "Turkey",
    "Palestine/West Bank" ~ "Palestine",
    "Palestine/Gaza"      ~ "Palestine",
    "Burma/Myanmar"      ~ "Myanmar",
    .default = country
  ))
```

## ACLED

### Name harmonisation

```{r}
# Harmonise country names to match WVS
acled <- acled_raw %>%
  mutate(country = case_match(
    country,
    "United States"  ~ "United States of America",
    "Czech Republic" ~ "Czechia",
    .default = country
  ))
```

### Event subsets

```{r echo = FALSE}
# Keyword pattern for women-targeted events
women_keywords <- c(
  "women", "woman", "female", "girls", "girl", "womens",
  "women's", "women and girls", "female protesters",
  "female protester", "women protesters", "women protester"
)
pattern <- str_c(women_keywords, collapse = "|")


# ACLED coverage per country (used later to flag pre-monitoring obs)
acled_coverage <- acled %>%
  group_by(country) %>%
  summarise(
    acled_first_year = min(year(as.Date(event_date))),
    acled_last_year  = max(year(as.Date(event_date))),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Event subsets
acled_gbv_state <- acled %>%
  filter(
    inter1 == 1, # it refers to violence perpetrated by the state
    event_type == "Violence against civilians" |
      sub_event_type %in% c("Arrests", 
                            "Excessive force against protesters"),
    str_detect(str_to_lower(assoc_actor_1), pattern)
  )

acled_only_gbv_state <- acled %>%
  filter(
    inter1 == 1,
    sub_event_type %in% c("Sexual violence", 
                          "Abduction/forced disappearance"),
    str_detect(str_to_lower(assoc_actor_1), pattern)
  )

acled_non_gbv_violence <- acled %>%
  filter(
    inter1 == 1,
    event_type == "Violence against civilians" |
      sub_event_type %in% c("Arrests", 
                            "Excessive force against protesters"),
    !str_detect(str_to_lower(assoc_actor_1), pattern)
  )

acled_women_protests <- acled %>%
  filter(
    sub_event_type %in% c(
      "Peaceful protest", "Protest with intervention",
      "Violent demonstration", "Excessive force against protesters"
    ),
    str_detect(str_to_lower(assoc_actor_1), pattern)
  )

acled_non_fem_protests <- acled %>%
  filter(
    sub_event_type %in% c(
      "Peaceful protest", "Protest with intervention",
      "Violent demonstration", "Excessive force against protesters"
    ),
    !str_detect(str_to_lower(assoc_actor_1), pattern)
  )
```

```{r warning = FALSE}
wvs <- wvs_raw %>%

  mutate(
    COUNTRY_ALPHA = as.character(as_factor(COUNTRY_ALPHA)),

    country = recode(

      "ALB" = "Albania",          "AND" = "Andorra",
      "ARG" = "Argentina",        "ARM" = "Armenia",
      "AUS" = "Australia",        "AZE" = "Azerbaijan",

      "BLR" = "Belarus",          "BOL" = "Bolivia",
      "BRA" = "Brazil",           "CAN" = "Canada",
      "CHE" = "Switzerland",      "CHL" = "Chile",
      "CHN" = "China",            "COL" = "Colombia",
      "CYP" = "Cyprus",           "CZE" = "Czechia",
      "DEU" = "Germany",          "DOM" = "Dominican Republic",
      "DZA" = "Algeria",          "ECU" = "Ecuador",
      "EGY" = "Egypt",            "ESP" = "Spain",
      "EST" = "Estonia",          "ETH" = "Ethiopia",
      "FIN" = "Finland",          "FRA" = "France",
      "GBR" = "United Kingdom",   "GEO" = "Georgia",
      "GHA" = "Ghana",            "GRC" = "Greece",
      "GTM" = "Guatemala",        "HKG" = "Hong Kong",
      "HRV" = "Croatia",          "HTI" = "Haiti",
      "HUN" = "Hungary",          "IDN" = "Indonesia",
      "IND" = "India",            "IRN" = "Iran",
      "IRQ" = "Iraq",             "ISR" = "Israel",
      "ITA" = "Italy",            "JOR" = "Jordan",
      "JPN" = "Japan",            "KAZ" = "Kazakhstan",
      "KEN" = "Kenya",            "KGZ" = "Kyrgyzstan",
      "KOR" = "South Korea",      "KWT" = "Kuwait",
      "LBN" = "Lebanon",          "LBY" = "Libya",
      "LTU" = "Lithuania",        "LVA" = "Latvia",
      "MAC" = "Macau SAR",        "MAR" = "Morocco",
      "MDA" = "Moldova",          "MDV" = "Maldives",
      "MEX" = "Mexico",           "MKD" = "North Macedonia",
      "MLI" = "Mali",             "MMR" = "Myanmar",
      "MNE" = "Montenegro",       "MNG" = "Mongolia",
      "MYS" = "Malaysia",         "NGA" = "Nigeria",
      "NIC" = "Nicaragua",        "NIR" = "Northern Ireland",
      "NLD" = "Netherlands",      "NOR" = "Norway",
      "NZL" = "New Zealand",      "PAK" = "Pakistan",
      "PER" = "Peru",             "PHL" = "Philippines",
      "POL" = "Poland",           "PRI" = "Puerto Rico",
      "PSE" = "Palestine",        "QAT" = "Qatar",
      "ROU" = "Romania",          "RUS" = "Russia",
      "RWA" = "Rwanda",           "SAU" = "Saudi Arabia",
      "SGP" = "Singapore",        "SLV" = "El Salvador",
      "SRB" = "Serbia",           "SVK" = "Slovakia",
      "SVN" = "Slovenia",         "SWE" = "Sweden",
      "THA" = "Thailand",         "TJK" = "Tajikistan",
      "TTO" = "Trinidad and Tobago", "TUN" = "Tunisia",
      "TUR" = "Turkey",           "TWN" = "Taiwan",
      "TZA" = "Tanzania",         "UGA" = "Uganda",
      "UKR" = "Ukraine",          "URY" = "Uruguay",
      "USA" = "United States of America", "UZB" = "Uzbekistan",
      "VEN" = "Venezuela",        "VNM" = "Vietnam",
      "YEM" = "Yemen",            "ZAF" = "South Africa",
      "ZMB" = "Zambia",           "ZWE" = "Zimbabwe",
      .default = NA_character_
    ),

    # --- Date variables ---
    S012_clean = S012 %>%
      na_if(-5) %>%
      na_if(-4) %>%
      na_if(-3) %>%
      na_if(-2) %>%
      na_if(-1),

    S022 = as.character(S022),
    S023 = as.character(S023),

    # Fieldwork start: first day of start month
    start_fw = if_else(
      is.na(S022) | S022 == "-5",
      as.Date(NA),
      ymd(paste0(S022, "01"), quiet = TRUE)
    ),

    # Fieldwork end: last day of end month
    end_fw = if_else(
      is.na(S023) | S023 == "-5",
      as.Date(NA),
      ymd(paste0(S023, "01"), quiet = TRUE) %m+% months(1) - days(1)
    ),

    # Fieldwork midpoint — available for all obs with both start and end
    midpoint_fw = if_else(
      !is.na(start_fw) & !is.na(end_fw),
      start_fw + as.integer((end_fw - start_fw) / 2),
      as.Date(NA)
    ),

    # Exact interview date — NA when not recorded (no fallback)
    date_interview = if_else(
      !is.na(S012_clean),
      ymd(as.character(S012_clean), quiet = TRUE),
      as.Date(NA)
    ),

    # date_interview_end: exact date; falls back to end_fw
    date_interview_end = if_else(
      !is.na(S012_clean),
      ymd(as.character(S012_clean), quiet = TRUE),
      end_fw
    ),

    # date_interview_start: exact date; falls back to start_fw
    date_interview_start = if_else(
      !is.na(S012_clean),
      ymd(as.character(S012_clean), quiet = TRUE),
      start_fw
    ),

    # date_interview_midpoint: exact date; falls back to midpoint_fw
    date_interview_midpoint = if_else(
      !is.na(S012_clean),
      ymd(as.character(S012_clean), quiet = TRUE),
      midpoint_fw
    ),

    # Flag: TRUE only for respondents with an exact interview date
    has_exact_date = !is.na(S012_clean),

    # --- Egalitarianism Index ---
    C001_clean = ifelse(C001 %in% c(1, 2, 3), C001, NA_real_),
    C001_R = recode(C001_clean, `1` = 1, `2` = 3, `3` = 2,
                    .default = NA_real_),

    D059_clean = ifelse(D059 %in% c(1, 2, 3, 4), D059, NA_real_),
    D059_R = recode(D059_clean, `1` = 1, `2` = 2, `3` = 3, `4` = 4),

    C001_norm = (C001_R - 1) / 2,
    D059_norm = (D059_R - 1) / 3,

    # Clean individual-level variables for recoding
    across(
      .cols = c(X001, X003, X025R, X047_WVS, E023, E033,
                E025, E026, E027, E028, X007, X028, S017, S018),
      .fns  = ~ .x %>%
        na_if(-5) %>% na_if(-4) %>% na_if(-3) %>% na_if(-2) %>% na_if(-1),
      .names = "{.col}"
    )
  ) %>%

  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    gender_norms_index_raw = mean(c(C001_norm, D059_norm), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%

  filter(!is.na(gender_norms_index_raw)) %>%

  transmute(
    # identifiers
    country             = country,
    wave                = S002VS,
    year                = S020,
    respondent_id       = S007,

    # date variables
    start_fw                = start_fw,
    end_fw                  = end_fw,
    midpoint_fw             = midpoint_fw,
    date_interview          = date_interview, # exact only, NA otherwise
    date_interview_end      = date_interview_end, # exact; fallback: end_fw
    date_interview_start    = date_interview_start, # exact; fallback: start_fw
    date_interview_midpoint = date_interview_midpoint, # exact; fallback: midpoint_fw
    has_exact_date          = has_exact_date,

    # egalitarianism
    jobs_scarce              = C001_norm,
    pol_leaders              = D059_norm,
    gender_norms_index_raw   = gender_norms_index_raw,

    # individual characteristics
    female = case_when(X001 == 1 ~ 0, X001 == 2 ~ 1, TRUE ~ NA_real_),
    age    = X003,

    edu_recoded = recode(X025R,
      `1` = "lower", `2` = "middle", `3` = "upper",
      .default = NA_character_),

    income           = X047_WVS,
    interest_politics = recode(E023, `1` = 4, `2` = 3, `3` = 2, `4` = 1),
    ideology         = E033,

    employment_status = recode(X028,
      `1` = "Full time",   `2` = "Part time",  `3` = "Self employed",
      `4` = "Retired",     `5` = "Housewife",  `6` = "Students",
      `7` = "Unemployed",  `8` = "Other",
      .default = NA_character_),

    employment_status_binary = recode(X028,
      `1` = 1, `2` = 1, `3` = 1,
      `4` = 0, `5` = 0, `6` = 0, `7` = 0, `8` = 0,
      .default = NA_real_),

    marital_status = recode(X007,
      `1` = "married",  `2` = "living together as married",
      `3` = "divorced", `4` = "separated",
      `5` = "widowed",  `6` = "single/never married",
      .default = NA_character_),

    marital_status_binary = recode(X007,
      `1` = 1, `2` = 1,
      `3` = 0, `4` = 0, `5` = 0, `6` = 0,
      .default = NA_real_),

    # dependent variable items
    petition = case_when(E025 %in% c(1,2) ~ 1, E025 == 3 ~ 0, TRUE ~ NA_real_),
    boycott  = case_when(E026 %in% c(1,2) ~ 1, E026 == 3 ~ 0, TRUE ~ NA_real_),
    demonst  = case_when(E027 %in% c(1,2) ~ 1, E027 == 3 ~ 0, TRUE ~ NA_real_),
    strike   = case_when(E028 %in% c(1,2) ~ 1, E028 == 3 ~ 0, TRUE ~ NA_real_),

    petition_char = recode(E025,
      `1` = "have done", `2` = "might do", `3` = "would not do",
      .default = NA_character_),
    boycott_char  = recode(E026,
      `1` = "have done", `2` = "might do", `3` = "would not do",
      .default = NA_character_),
    demonst_char  = recode(E027,
      `1` = "have done", `2` = "might do", `3` = "would not do",
      .default = NA_character_),
    strike_char   = recode(E028,
      `1` = "have done", `2` = "might do", `3` = "would not do",
      .default = NA_character_),

    # interview privacy (S013B): 1=private, 0=others present, NA=-4/-5
    interview_privacy = case_when(
      S013B == 1 ~ 1,
      S013B == 2 ~ 0,
      TRUE       ~ NA_real_
    ),

    # weights
    weight               = S017,
    equilibrated_weight  = S018
  ) %>%

  # macro egalitarianism (country-year mean)
  group_by(country, year) %>%
  mutate(gender_norms_macro = mean(gender_norms_index_raw, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%

  # row id for joining back after exposure calculation
  mutate(row_id = row_number())
```

# Creating Exposure

## Function

```{r}

# One function handles every date reference type and 3 rolling windows.
# Returns a data frame with row_id + 3 new columns per call.

# Windows: roll180, roll365, roll730 — rolling N days back from ref_date.

# Date suffix naming convention:
#   exact   — individual exact interview date (has_exact_date == TRUE only)
#   fwmid   — fieldwork midpoint anchor, primary strategy (same for all in CY)
#   fwstart — fieldwork start anchor, robustness alternative

calculate_exposure <- function(wvs_df, acled_df, prefix,
                               date_col, exact_only = FALSE) {

  if (exact_only) wvs_df <- filter(wvs_df, has_exact_date)

  wvs_df <- wvs_df %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[date_col]])) %>%
    mutate(ref_date = .data[[date_col]])

  common_countries <- intersect(unique(wvs_df$country), unique(acled_df$country))

  map_df(common_countries, function(ctry) {

    w_sub <- wvs_df %>%
      filter(country == ctry) %>%
      select(row_id, country, ref_date) %>%
      mutate(
        start_180 = ref_date - days(180),
        start_365 = ref_date - days(365),
        start_730 = ref_date - days(730)
      )

    a_sub <- acled_df %>%
      filter(country == ctry) %>%
      mutate(event_date = as.Date(event_date)) %>%
      count(country, event_date, name = "n_events")

    if (nrow(a_sub) == 0) return(NULL)

    w_sub %>%
      inner_join(a_sub, by = "country", relationship = "many-to-many") %>%
      group_by(row_id) %>%
      summarise(
        !!paste0(prefix, "_roll180") := sum(n_events[event_date >= start_180 & event_date <= ref_date], na.rm = TRUE),
        !!paste0(prefix, "_roll365") := sum(n_events[event_date >= start_365 & event_date <= ref_date], na.rm = TRUE),
        !!paste0(prefix, "_roll730") := sum(n_events[event_date >= start_730 & event_date <= ref_date], na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
  })
}
```

## Configuration

```{r}
# Five ACLED event type subsets
acled_subsets <- list(
  gbv_st     = acled_gbv_state,
  gbv_strict = acled_only_gbv_state,
  non_gbv_st = acled_non_gbv_violence,
  w_prot     = acled_women_protests,
  gen_prot   = acled_non_fem_protests
)

# Three date reference configurations (end/start/mid dropped — unused in analysis)
date_configs <- list(
  list(col = "date_interview", suffix = "exact",   exact_only = TRUE),
  list(col = "start_fw",       suffix = "fwstart", exact_only = FALSE),
  list(col = "midpoint_fw",    suffix = "fwmid",   exact_only = FALSE)
)
```

## Run (15 combinations: 3 date types × 5 event types)

```{r}
all_exposure_results <- list()

for (dc in date_configs) {
  for (ev_name in names(acled_subsets)) {

    key <- paste0(ev_name, "_", dc$suffix)
    cat("Computing:", key, "\n")

    all_exposure_results[[key]] <- calculate_exposure(
      wvs_df     = wvs,
      acled_df   = acled_subsets[[ev_name]],
      prefix     = key,
      date_col   = dc$col,
      exact_only = dc$exact_only
    )
  }
}

# Join all 15 result tables back to wvs in one step
wvs_exposure <- reduce(
  all_exposure_results,
  ~ left_join(.x, .y, by = "row_id"),
  .init = wvs
)
```

## ACLED Monitoring Window Correction

```{r}
# Converts join-NAs to 0 when ACLED was actively monitoring but saw no events.
# Keeps NA when the reference date falls outside the monitoring window.
# Each date type uses its own reference year for the check.

correct_acled_coverage <- function(df, ref_year_col, ref_month_col, var_pattern) {
  ry <- df[[ref_year_col]]
  rm <- df[[ref_month_col]]
  # Window-start year approximation (calendar-year level):
  #   roll730 → always subtract 2 years
  #   roll365 → always subtract 1 year (365-day window always touches prior year)
  #   roll180 → month-aware: midpoint in Jan-Jun crosses into prior year (-1);
  # midpoint in Jul-Dec stays within current year (-0).
  # Threshold: 180 days before Jul 1 = Jan 1, so month >= 7 is safe.
  window_back_years <- function(col_name, ref_months) {
    if (grepl("roll730", col_name)) return(2L)
    if (grepl("roll365",         col_name)) return(1L)
    if (grepl("roll180",         col_name)) return(if_else(ref_months >= 7L, 0L, 1L))
    return(0L)
  }
  df %>%
    mutate(across(
      .cols = matches(var_pattern),
      .fns  = function(x) {
        wsy <- ry - window_back_years(cur_column(), rm)
        case_when(
          is.na(.data$acled_first_year)                                 ~ NA_real_,
          wsy < .data$acled_first_year                                  ~ NA_real_,
          !is.na(.data$acled_last_year) & ry > .data$acled_last_year   ~ NA_real_,
          is.na(x)                                                      ~ 0,
          TRUE                                                          ~ as.numeric(x)
        )
      }
    ))
}

wvs_exposure <- wvs_exposure %>%
  left_join(acled_coverage, by = "country") %>%
  mutate(
    ry_exact   = if_else(!is.na(date_interview),
                         as.integer(year(date_interview)),  NA_integer_),
    rm_exact   = if_else(!is.na(date_interview),
                         as.integer(month(date_interview)), NA_integer_),
    ry_fwstart = if_else(!is.na(start_fw),
                         as.integer(year(start_fw)),        NA_integer_),
    rm_fwstart = if_else(!is.na(start_fw),
                         as.integer(month(start_fw)),       NA_integer_),
    ry_fwmid   = if_else(!is.na(midpoint_fw),
                         as.integer(year(midpoint_fw)),     NA_integer_),
    rm_fwmid   = if_else(!is.na(midpoint_fw),
                         as.integer(month(midpoint_fw)),    NA_integer_)
  ) %>%
  correct_acled_coverage("ry_exact",   "rm_exact",   "_exact_(roll|ytd)")   %>%
  correct_acled_coverage("ry_fwstart", "rm_fwstart", "_fwstart_(roll|ytd)") %>%
  correct_acled_coverage("ry_fwmid",   "rm_fwmid",   "_fwmid_(roll|ytd)")   %>%
  select(-acled_first_year, -acled_last_year,
         -starts_with("ry_"), -starts_with("rm_"))

# Remove Canada (incomplete ACLED coverage for this sample)
wvs_exposure <- filter(wvs_exposure, country != "Canada")
```

# Joining Economic Data

## Download and Clean World Bank

```{r}
# Indicators:
# NY.GDP.PCAP.PP.KD = GDP per capita, PPP (constant 2017 international $)
# NY.GDP.MKTP.KD    = GDP (constant 2015 US$)
# NY.GDP.MKTP.KD.ZG = GDP growth (annual %)
# SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS    = Unemployment, total (% of total labor force)
# FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG    = Inflation, consumer prices (annual %)

wb_raw <- WDI(
  indicator = c(
    "wb_gdp_pcap"  = "NY.GDP.PCAP.PP.KD",
    "wb_gdp_total" = "NY.GDP.MKTP.KD",
    "wb_growth"    = "NY.GDP.MKTP.KD.ZG",
    "wb_unemp"     = "SL.UEM.TOTL.ZS",
    "wb_infl"      = "FP.CPI.TOTL.ZG"
  ),
  start = 1990,
  end   = 2024,
  extra = TRUE
)

wb_clean <- wb_raw %>%
  filter(region != "Aggregates") %>%
  mutate(
    country = recode(country,
      "Egypt, Arab Rep."     = "Egypt",
      "Hong Kong SAR, China" = "Hong Kong",
      "Iran, Islamic Rep."   = "Iran",
      "Korea, Rep."          = "South Korea",
      "Kyrgyz Republic"      = "Kyrgyzstan",
      "Macao SAR, China"     = "Macau SAR",
      "Puerto Rico (US)"     = "Puerto Rico",
      "Russian Federation"   = "Russia",
      "Slovak Republic"      = "Slovakia",
      "Turkiye"              = "Turkey",
      "United States"        = "United States of America",
      "Venezuela, RB"        = "Venezuela",
      "Viet Nam"             = "Vietnam",
      "Yemen, Rep."          = "Yemen",
      "West Bank and Gaza"   = "Palestine"
    ),
    country = trimws(as.character(country)),
    year    = as.numeric(year)
  ) %>%
  select(country, year, wb_gdp_pcap, wb_gdp_total, wb_growth, wb_unemp, wb_infl)
```

## Normal Variables

```{r}
joint_data <- joint_data %>%
  mutate(country = trimws(as.character(country)), year = as.numeric(year)) %>%
  left_join(wb_clean, by = c("country", "year")) %>%
  group_by(country) %>%
  mutate(
    # --- A. GDP PER CAPITA (Ratio Scaling) ---
    gdp_wb_thousands  = wb_gdp_pcap / 1000,
    ratio             = mean(gdp_capita / gdp_wb_thousands, na.rm = TRUE),
    ratio             = ifelse(is.nan(ratio), 1, ratio),
    gdp_wb_scaled     = gdp_wb_thousands * ratio,
    gdp_capita_final  = ifelse(is.na(gdp_capita), gdp_wb_scaled, gdp_capita),
    is_wb_gdp_capita  = ifelse(is.na(gdp_capita) & !is.na(wb_gdp_pcap), 1, 0),

    # --- B. TOTAL GDP (Ratio Scaling) ---
    ratio_total     = mean(gdp / wb_gdp_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    ratio_total     = ifelse(is.nan(ratio_total) | is.infinite(ratio_total), 1, ratio_total),
    gdp_total_final = ifelse(is.na(gdp), wb_gdp_total * ratio_total, gdp),
    is_wb_gdp_total = ifelse(is.na(gdp) & !is.na(wb_gdp_total), 1, 0),

    # --- C. RATES & PERCENTAGES (Direct Patch) ---
    inflation_final    = ifelse(is.na(inflation), wb_infl, inflation),
    is_wb_infl         = ifelse(is.na(inflation) & !is.na(wb_infl), 1, 0),
    gdp_growth         = wb_growth,
    unemployment_final = wb_unemp,

    # --- D. MISERY INDEX ---
    misery_index = inflation_final + unemployment_final
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Harmonisation checks
cor(joint_data$gdp_capita,   joint_data$gdp_wb_scaled,   use = "complete.obs")
cor(joint_data$gdp,          joint_data$gdp_total_final, use = "complete.obs")

ggplot(joint_data, aes(x = gdp_capita, y = gdp_wb_scaled)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "red") +
  labs(title = "Harmonisation Check: V-Dem vs. Scaled WB GDP per capita",
       x = "Original V-Dem", y = "Scaled World Bank") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Lag Variables

```{r}
wb_lagged <- wb_raw %>%
  filter(region != "Aggregates") %>%
  mutate(
    country = recode(country,
      "Egypt, Arab Rep."     = "Egypt",
      "Hong Kong SAR, China" = "Hong Kong",
      "Iran, Islamic Rep."   = "Iran",
      "Korea, Rep."          = "South Korea",
      "Kyrgyz Republic"      = "Kyrgyzstan",
      "Macao SAR, China"     = "Macau SAR",
      "Puerto Rico (US)"     = "Puerto Rico",
      "Russian Federation"   = "Russia",
      "Slovak Republic"      = "Slovakia",
      "Turkiye"              = "Turkey",
      "United States"        = "United States of America",
      "Venezuela, RB"        = "Venezuela",
      "Viet Nam"             = "Vietnam",
      "Yemen, Rep."          = "Yemen",
      "West Bank and Gaza"   = "Palestine"
    ),
    country = trimws(as.character(country)),
    year    = as.numeric(year)
  ) %>%
  group_by(country) %>%
  arrange(year) %>%
  mutate(
    wb_gdp_pcap_lag  = lag(wb_gdp_pcap, 1),
    wb_gdp_total_lag = lag(wb_gdp_total, 1),
    wb_infl_lag      = lag(wb_infl, 1),
    wb_growth_lag    = lag(wb_growth, 1),
    wb_unemp_lag     = lag(wb_unemp, 1)
  ) %>%
  select(country, year, contains("_lag")) %>%
  ungroup()

joint_data <- joint_data %>%
  left_join(wb_lagged, by = c("country", "year")) %>%
  group_by(country) %>%
  mutate(
    # --- A. LAGGED GDP PER CAPITA ---
    gdp_wb_lag_k         = wb_gdp_pcap_lag / 1000,
    ratio_lag            = mean(gdp_capita_lagged / gdp_wb_lag_k, na.rm = TRUE),
    ratio_lag            = ifelse(is.nan(ratio_lag) | is.infinite(ratio_lag), 1, ratio_lag),
    gdp_wb_lag_scaled    = gdp_wb_lag_k * ratio_lag,
    gdp_capita_lag_final = ifelse(is.na(gdp_capita_lagged), gdp_wb_lag_scaled, gdp_capita_lagged),

    # --- B. LAGGED RATES ---
    infl_lag_final   = ifelse(is.na(inflation_lagged), wb_infl_lag, inflation_lagged),
    unemp_lag_final  = wb_unemp_lag,
    growth_lag_final = wb_growth_lag,

    # --- C. LAGGED MISERY INDEX ---
    misery_index_lag = infl_lag_final + unemp_lag_final
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Harmonisation checks
cor(joint_data$gdp_capita_lagged, joint_data$gdp_wb_lag_scaled, use = "complete.obs")
cor(joint_data$gdp,               joint_data$gdp_total_final,   use = "complete.obs")
```

## Manual Imputation of Missing Values

```{r}
# Sources: IMF World Economic Outlook / World Bank where noted

joint_data <- joint_data %>%
  mutate(
    # --- INFLATION ---
    inflation_final = case_when(
      country == "Taiwan"        & year == 2019 ~ 0.6,
      country == "Myanmar" & year == 2020 ~ 2.2,  # IMF
      country == "Tajikistan"    & year == 2020 ~ 8.6,  # IMF
      country == "Venezuela"     & year == 2021 ~ 1590, # IMF
      TRUE ~ inflation_final
    ),

    infl_lag_final = case_when(
      country == "Taiwan"     & year == 2019 ~ 1.4,
      country == "Tajikistan" & year == 2020 ~ 7.8,    # IMF
      country == "Venezuela"  & year == 2021 ~ 2360,
      TRUE ~ infl_lag_final
    ),

    # --- UNEMPLOYMENT ---
    unemployment_final = case_when(
      country == "Taiwan" & year == 2019 ~ 3.7,         # IMF
      TRUE ~ unemployment_final
    ),

    unemp_lag_final = case_when(
      country == "Taiwan" & year == 2019 ~ 3.7,         # IMF
      TRUE ~ unemp_lag_final
    ),

    # --- GDP PER CAPITA ---
    # NOTE: gdp_capita_final / gdp_capita_lag_final are in THOUSANDS of USD
    # (consistent with VDEM e_gdppc and the /1000 applied to WB data at line 713).
    # Venezuela values sourced from IMF WEO; raw-dollar figures divided by 1000.
    gdp_capita_final = case_when(
      country == "Venezuela" & year == 2021 ~ 2.090,    # IMF WEO NGDPDPC 2021 / 1000
      TRUE ~ gdp_capita_final
    ),

    gdp_capita_lag_final = case_when(
      country == "Venezuela" & year == 2021 ~ 1.567,    # IMF WEO NGDPDPC 2020 / 1000
      TRUE ~ gdp_capita_lag_final
    ),

    # --- GROWTH ---
    gdp_growth = case_when(
      country == "Taiwan" & year == 2019 ~ 3.1,
      TRUE ~ gdp_growth
    ),

    growth_lag_final = case_when(
      country == "Taiwan" & year == 2019 ~ 2.9,
      TRUE ~ growth_lag_final
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    misery_index     = inflation_final + unemployment_final,
    misery_index_lag = infl_lag_final  + unemp_lag_final
  )
```

# Ratios

```{r}
# Gend Rep ratio: share of state violence that is women-targeted
# Formula: gbv_st / (gbv_st + non_gbv_st + 1)
# The +1 Laplace smoothing avoids division by zero in low-event country-years.
# Computed for all date-type x window combinations.

date_suffixes   <- c("exact", "fwstart", "fwmid")
window_suffixes <- c("roll180", "roll365", "roll730")

for (ds in date_suffixes) {
  for (ws in window_suffixes) {
    gbv_col   <- paste0("gbv_st_",    ds, "_", ws)
    nonbgv_col <- paste0("non_gbv_st_", ds, "_", ws)
    ratio_col  <- paste0("gbv_ratio_",  ds, "_", ws)

    joint_data <- joint_data %>%
      mutate(!!ratio_col :=
               .data[[gbv_col]] / (.data[[gbv_col]] + .data[[nonbgv_col]] + 1))
  }
}
```

# Log Transformations and Standardisation

```{r}
joint_data <- joint_data %>%
  mutate(

    # --- A. ECONOMIC VARIABLES ---
    # Inflation: winsorise at 99th pct then floor at 0 before log1p
    infl_capped         = pmin(inflation_final,
                               quantile(inflation_final, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)),
    log_inflation       = log1p(pmax(0, infl_capped)),

    infl_lag_capped     = pmin(infl_lag_final,
                               quantile(infl_lag_final, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)),
    log_inflation_lag   = log1p(pmax(0, infl_lag_capped)),

    # Misery index
    log_misery          = log1p(pmax(0, misery_index)),
    log_misery_lag      = log1p(pmax(0, misery_index_lag)),

    # GDP per capita
    log_gdp_capita      = log(pmax(1, gdp_capita_final)),
    log_gdp_capita_lag  = log(pmax(1, gdp_capita_lag_final)),
    log_gdp_total       = log(pmax(1, gdp_total_final)),

    # Unemployment
    log_unemp           = log1p(pmax(0, unemployment_final)),
    log_unemp_lag       = log1p(pmax(0, unemp_lag_final)),

    # Growth: can be negative — winsorise only, no log
    gdp_growth_capped   = pmin(pmax(gdp_growth,
                                    quantile(gdp_growth, 0.01, na.rm = TRUE)),
                               quantile(gdp_growth, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)),
    growth_lag_capped   = pmin(pmax(growth_lag_final,
                                    quantile(growth_lag_final, 0.01, na.rm = TRUE)),
                               quantile(growth_lag_final, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)),

    # --- B. VIOLENCE AND PROTEST COUNTS ---
    # Log-transform all non_gbv_st and gen_prot count variables
    across(
      matches("^non_gbv_st_(exact|fwstart|fwmid)_"),
      ~ log1p(pmax(0, .)),
      .names = "log_{.col}"
    ),
    across(
      matches("^gen_prot_(exact|fwstart|fwmid)_"),
      ~ log1p(pmax(0, .)),
      .names = "log_{.col}"
    ),

    # --- C. STANDARDISATION (Z-SCORES) ---
    # Gend Rep ratios: standardise only, no log
    across(
      matches("^gbv_ratio_(exact|fwstart|fwmid)_"),
      ~ as.numeric(scale(.)),
      .names = "{.col}_z"
    ),

    # Log-transformed economic variables
    across(
      c(log_inflation, log_inflation_lag,
        log_misery, log_misery_lag,
        log_gdp_capita, log_gdp_capita_lag, log_gdp_total,
        log_unemp, log_unemp_lag),
      ~ as.numeric(scale(.)),
      .names = "{.col}_z"
    ),

    # Winsorised growth (no log)
    gdp_growth_z    = as.numeric(scale(gdp_growth_capped)),
    growth_lag_z    = as.numeric(scale(growth_lag_capped)),

    # Log violence and protest counts
    across(
      matches("^log_non_gbv_st_(exact|fwstart|fwmid)_"),
      ~ as.numeric(scale(.)),
      .names = "{.col}_z"
    ),
    across(
      matches("^log_gen_prot_(exact|fwstart|fwmid)_"),
      ~ as.numeric(scale(.)),
      .names = "{.col}_z"
    ),

    # VDEM and norms
    gender_norms_z    = as.numeric(scale(gender_norms_macro)),
    cso_repression_z  = as.numeric(scale(cso_repression)),
    edi_z             = as.numeric(scale(edi)),
    wpe_z             = as.numeric(scale(women_political_empowerment))
  )
```

# Weighted Dependent Variables (Kwak Strategy)

The Kwak approach recodes the three-category participation items: - "would not do" → 0 - "might do" → 1 (full weight: intention is current) - "have done" → individual predicted probability of currently participating (down-weights past behaviour by how likely someone *like them* would do it today)

The propensity model uses age, gender, education, EDI, log GDP per capita, and general protest climate (`log_gen_prot_fwmid_roll180`) as predictors. This uses the fieldwork-midpoint Roll-180 window: a country-year constant and therefore exogenous to individual interview timing, consistent with the primary exposure specification used throughout the analysis.

```{r}
library(lme4)

run_kwak <- function(data, item_char, item_bin, score_col, protest_var) {

  # Step 1: binary indicator for final scoring (have done + might do = 1, NA stays NA)
  data[[item_bin]] <- case_when(
    data[[item_char]] %in% c("have done", "might do") ~ 1,
    is.na(data[[item_char]])                           ~ NA_real_,
    TRUE                                               ~ 0
  )

  # Step 2: propensity model — trained only on current-intent respondents "might do" = 1, "would not" = 0; "have done" excluded from training to avoid circularity (past behaviour ≠ current willingness).

  # Strip haven_labelled and other special attributes from predictors so thatmodel.matrix produces consistent design matrices across subsets.
  plain_vars <- c("age", "female", "edi", "log_gdp_capita", protest_var)
  for (v in plain_vars) {
    if (v %in% names(data)) data[[v]] <- as.numeric(data[[v]])
  }
  # edu_recoded: convert to plain factor with all levels from the full data
  edu_levels <- sort(unique(as.character(data[["edu_recoded"]])))
  edu_levels <- edu_levels[!is.na(edu_levels)]
  data[["edu_recoded"]] <- factor(as.character(data[["edu_recoded"]]),
                                  levels = edu_levels)

  train_data <- data[data[[item_char]] != "have done", ]
  train_data[[item_bin]] <- ifelse(train_data[[item_char]] == "might do", 1, 0)

  formula_str <- paste0(
    item_bin, " ~ age + female + edu_recoded + edi + ",
    "log_gdp_capita + ", protest_var,
    " + (1 | country) + (1 | year)"
  )
  mod <- glmer(as.formula(formula_str),
               data = train_data, family = binomial,
               na.action = na.exclude)

  # Step 3: predicted probability
  # Training rows ("might do" / "would not"): use in-sample fitted values directly to avoid any newdata design-matrix conformability issue. "have done" rows: predict out-of-sample on a clean subset.
  prob_col <- paste0(item_char %>% gsub("_char", "", .), "_prob")
  data[[prob_col]] <- NA_real_

  train_row_idx <- as.integer(rownames(train_data))
  data[[prob_col]][train_row_idx] <- as.numeric(fitted(mod))

  hd_idx <- which(data[[item_char]] == "have done")
  if (length(hd_idx) > 0) {
    # Manually compute fixed-effects prediction for "have done" rows.
    # Using predict(newdata=) fails when a factor level is absent from train_data (glmer drops the zero-row column; the newdata design matrix keeps it).
    # I intersect to only the columns the model actually estimated.
    beta <- fixef(mod)
    fe_formula <- as.formula(paste0(
      "~ age + female + edu_recoded + edi + log_gdp_capita + ", protest_var
    ))
    X_hd <- model.matrix(fe_formula, data = data[hd_idx, ])
    keep <- intersect(colnames(X_hd), names(beta))
    data[[prob_col]][hd_idx] <- plogis(
      as.numeric(X_hd[, keep, drop = FALSE] %*% beta[keep])
    )
  }

  # Step 4: Kwak score
  # "would not" → 0; "have done" → p(currently willing); "might do" → 1
  data[[score_col]] <- case_when(
    data[[item_bin]] == 0            ~ 0,
    data[[item_char]] == "have done" ~ data[[prob_col]],
    data[[item_bin]] == 1            ~ 1,
    TRUE                             ~ NA_real_
  )

  return(data)
}

protest_var <- "log_gen_prot_fwmid_roll180"

# Run Kwak on all respondents with valid roll-180 womden directed violence exposure (primary window).
# Using roll180 protest covariate ensures China/Colombia (acled_first_year=2018) are included

kwak_sample <- joint_data %>% filter(!is.na(gbv_st_fwmid_roll180))

kwak_sample <- run_kwak(kwak_sample, "petition_char", "petition_would",
                        "petition_kwak_score", protest_var)
kwak_sample <- run_kwak(kwak_sample, "boycott_char",  "boycott_would",
                        "boycott_kwak_score",  protest_var)
kwak_sample <- run_kwak(kwak_sample, "demonst_char",  "demonst_would",
                        "demonst_kwak_score",  protest_var)
kwak_sample <- run_kwak(kwak_sample, "strike_char",   "strike_would",
                        "strike_kwak_score",   protest_var)

# Merge Kwak scores back into joint_data
# Drop any pre-existing Kwak columns (present if this chunk is re-run in session)
joint_data <- joint_data %>%
  select(-any_of(c("petition_kwak_score", "boycott_kwak_score",
                    "demonst_kwak_score",  "strike_kwak_score")))

joint_data <- joint_data %>%
  left_join(
    kwak_sample %>% select(row_id,
                            petition_kwak_score, boycott_kwak_score,
                            demonst_kwak_score,  strike_kwak_score),
    by = "row_id"
  )
```

## Kwak Sanity Check

```{r kwak-sanity}
# ── Critical check: mean Kwak score BY response category ─────────────────────
# Expected:  "would not do" → mean = 0
# "might do"  → mean = 1 ← if missing, the fix didn't work
# "have done" → mean in (0,1) ← predicted probability

items_check  <- c("petition", "boycott", "demonst", "strike")
char_check   <- paste0(items_check, "_char")
kwak_check   <- paste0(items_check, "_kwak_score")
labels_check <- c("Petition", "Boycott", "Demonstration", "Strike")

for (i in seq_along(items_check)) {
  cat("---", labels_check[i], "---\n")
  print(
    joint_data %>%
      filter(!is.na(.data[[char_check[i]]]),
             !is.na(.data[[kwak_check[i]]])) %>%
      group_by(response = .data[[char_check[i]]]) %>%
      summarise(
        n    = n(),
        mean = round(mean(.data[[kwak_check[i]]], na.rm = TRUE), 3),
        min  = round(min(.data[[kwak_check[i]]],  na.rm = TRUE), 3),
        max  = round(max(.data[[kwak_check[i]]],  na.rm = TRUE), 3),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      as.data.frame()
  )
  cat("\n")
}

# ── Valid N and overall means ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
cat("=== VALID N AND OVERALL MEAN PER ACTIVITY ===\n")
for (i in seq_along(items_check)) {
  n_valid <- sum(!is.na(joint_data[[kwak_check[i]]]))
  m       <- round(mean(joint_data[[kwak_check[i]]], na.rm = TRUE), 3)
  cat(sprintf("%-14s  N = %6d   mean = %.3f\n", labels_check[i], n_valid, m))
}
```

# CFA — Confirmatory Factor Analysis

```{r}
library(lavaan)

# Analysis sample: men only, with valid main exposure variable.

final_sample_data <- subset(joint_data,
                             female == 0 & !is.na(gbv_st_fwmid_roll180))

activism_model <- '
  Activism =~ petition_kwak_score + boycott_kwak_score + demonst_kwak_score + strike_kwak_score
'
```

## One-Factor Model

```{r}
fit_cfa_final <- cfa(activism_model, data = final_sample_data)
summary(fit_cfa_final, fit.measures = TRUE, standardized = TRUE)
```

## Two-Factor Model

Instead of public and private mobilization potential, they were originally labelled as high-risk and low-risk mobilization potential respectively. Nevertheless, they refer to public and private mobilization as identified in the final text.

```{r}
two_factor_model <- '
  low_risk  =~ petition_kwak_score + boycott_kwak_score
  high_risk =~ strike_kwak_score   + demonst_kwak_score
'

fit_2 <- cfa(two_factor_model, data = final_sample_data, missing = "fiml")
summary(fit_2, fit.measures = TRUE)
```

## Extracting Latent Scores

### One factor (FIML)

```{r}
# FIML handles partial missingness on the four items without listwise deletion
fit_cfa_fiml <- cfa(activism_model,
                    data    = final_sample_data,
                    missing = "fiml")

scores_fiml  <- lavPredict(fit_cfa_fiml)
used_indices <- lavInspect(fit_cfa_fiml, "case.idx")

final_sample_data$activism_latent <- NA
final_sample_data$activism_latent[used_indices] <- as.numeric(scores_fiml)

cat("N with activism_latent:", sum(!is.na(final_sample_data$activism_latent)), "\n")
```

### Two factors

```{r}
scores_2fac    <- lavPredict(fit_2)
used_idx_2fac  <- lavInspect(fit_2, "case.idx")

final_sample_data$low_risk_latent  <- NA
final_sample_data$high_risk_latent <- NA

final_sample_data$low_risk_latent[used_idx_2fac]  <-
  as.numeric(scores_2fac[, "low_risk"])
final_sample_data$high_risk_latent[used_idx_2fac] <-
  as.numeric(scores_2fac[, "high_risk"])

# Min-max rescale to 0-1
final_sample_data <- final_sample_data %>%
  mutate(
    activism_low_final  = (low_risk_latent  - min(low_risk_latent,  na.rm = TRUE)) /
                          (max(low_risk_latent,  na.rm = TRUE) - min(low_risk_latent,  na.rm = TRUE)),
    activism_high_final = (high_risk_latent - min(high_risk_latent, na.rm = TRUE)) /
                          (max(high_risk_latent, na.rm = TRUE) - min(high_risk_latent, na.rm = TRUE))
  )
```

## Main DV: activism_final (min-max rescaled one-factor score)

```{r}
final_sample_data <- final_sample_data %>%
  mutate(
    activism_final = (activism_latent - min(activism_latent, na.rm = TRUE)) /
                     (max(activism_latent, na.rm = TRUE) - min(activism_latent, na.rm = TRUE))
  )
```

## Coverage Check Across Windows

```{r}
# Coverage check: how many CYs have a valid DV and each rolling exposure window?
# Exposure variable: gbv_ratio_fwmid_roll*_z (fwmid anchor, primary strategy)
# Windows: Roll-180 (primary), Roll-365, Roll-730 (robustness)
# ACLED coverage correction applied upstream means longer windows are stricter.

coverage_check <- final_sample_data %>%
  group_by(country, year) %>%
  summarise(
    n_resp       = n(),
    has_dv       = sum(!is.na(activism_high_final))           > 0,
    has_r180     = sum(!is.na(gbv_ratio_fwmid_roll180_z))     > 0,
    has_r365     = sum(!is.na(gbv_ratio_fwmid_roll365_z))     > 0,
    has_r730     = sum(!is.na(gbv_ratio_fwmid_roll730_z))     > 0,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cy_dv <- sum(coverage_check$has_dv)
cat("CYs with valid DV:        ", cy_dv, "\n")
cat("CYs valid — Roll-180:     ", sum(coverage_check$has_dv & coverage_check$has_r180), "\n")
cat("CYs valid — Roll-365:     ", sum(coverage_check$has_dv & coverage_check$has_r365), "\n")
cat("CYs valid — Roll-730:     ", sum(coverage_check$has_dv & coverage_check$has_r730), "\n")

cat("\nCYs lost relative to DV:\n")
coverage_check %>%
  filter(has_dv) %>%
  summarise(
    lost_r180 = sum(!has_r180),
    lost_r365 = sum(!has_r365),
    lost_r730 = sum(!has_r730)
  ) %>%
  print()

cat("\nCYs in Roll-180 but not Roll-730 (excluded by 2-year coverage requirement):\n")
coverage_check %>%
  filter(has_dv & has_r180 & !has_r730) %>%
  select(country, year) %>%
  arrange(country) %>%
  print(n = Inf)
```

## Add Freedom-of-Expression Control (v2x_freexp_altinf)

`v2x_freexp_altinf` was not included in the original VDEM `transmute()`. It is joined here from `vdem_raw` (already in memory) using the same country-name harmonisation applied earlier in the pipeline. This index captures freedom of expression and access to alternative information sources (press freedom + internet + civil society media), ranging 0–1. It serves as a control for the information-diffusion assumption: not everyone in a country is equally exposed to repression events, and how freely information circulates conditions individual-level exposure.

```{r}
# Pull v2x_freexp_altinf from the already-loaded vdem_raw
freexp_df <- vdem_raw %>%
  transmute(
    country       = country_name,
    year          = year,
    freexp_altinf = v2x_freexp_altinf
  ) %>%
  mutate(country = case_match(
    country,
    "Türkiye"             ~ "Turkey",
    "Palestine/West Bank" ~ "Palestine",
    "Palestine/Gaza"      ~ "Palestine",
    "Burma/Myanmar"       ~ "Myanmar",
    .default = country
  ))

# Drop any prior version (safety for re-runs), join, z-score
final_sample_data <- final_sample_data %>%
  select(-any_of(c("freexp_altinf", "freexp_altinf_z"))) %>%
  left_join(freexp_df, by = c("country", "year")) %>%
  mutate(freexp_altinf_z = as.numeric(scale(freexp_altinf)))

# Coverage check
cat("N with freexp_altinf    :", sum(!is.na(final_sample_data$freexp_altinf)),   "\n")
cat("N missing freexp_altinf :", sum(is.na(final_sample_data$freexp_altinf)),    "\n")
cat("Country-years covered   :",
    final_sample_data %>%
      filter(!is.na(freexp_altinf)) %>%
      distinct(country, year) %>% nrow(), "\n")
```

## Country-Year Sample Plot

```{r desc-cy-dot, fig.width=9, fig.height=8}
# Dot plot: one dot per country, x = number of waves in sample
country_counts <- vis_sample %>%
  group_by(country) %>%
  summarise(n_years = n_distinct(year), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(group = factor(case_when(
    n_years == 1 ~ "1 wave",
    n_years == 2 ~ "2 waves",
    n_years >= 3 ~ "3+ waves"
  ), levels = c("1 wave", "2 waves", "3+ waves")))

plot_data <- country_counts %>%
  arrange(desc(n_years), country) %>%
  mutate(country = factor(country, levels = rev(unique(country))))

mid <- ceiling(nrow(plot_data) / 2)
countries_sorted <- levels(plot_data$country)
data_left  <- plot_data %>%
  filter(country %in% rev(countries_sorted)[1:mid]) %>%
  mutate(country = factor(country, levels = rev(unique(as.character(country)))))
data_right <- plot_data %>%
  filter(country %in% rev(countries_sorted)[(mid + 1):length(countries_sorted)]) %>%
  mutate(country = factor(country, levels = rev(unique(as.character(country)))))

dot_theme <- function() {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11, base_family = "serif") +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor    = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y  = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y        = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x         = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.text.y         = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.position     = "none"
  )
}

p_dot_l <- ggplot(data_left, aes(x = n_years, y = country, color = group)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 1, xend = n_years, yend = country), color = "grey88") +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("1 wave" = "#FD7E14",
                                "2 waves" = "#E63946",
                                "3+ waves" = "#821115")) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(1, max(plot_data$n_years)), breaks = 1:5) +
  dot_theme() + labs(x = "WVS waves in sample")

p_dot_r <- ggplot(data_right, aes(x = n_years, y = country, color = group)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 1, xend = n_years, yend = country), color = "grey88") +
  geom_point(size = 2.5) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("1 wave" = "#FD7E14",
                                "2 waves" = "#E63946",
                                "3+ waves" = "#821115")) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(1, max(plot_data$n_years)), breaks = 1:5) +
  dot_theme() + labs(x = "WVS waves in sample")

(p_dot_l | p_dot_r)
ggsave("country_sample_clean.pdf", plot = (p_dot_l | p_dot_r),
       width = 9, height = 8, device = "pdf")
```

## Wave Distribution over Time

```{r desc-timeline, fig.width=11, fig.height=9, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ── Timeline: which years each country appears in the sample ─────────────────

# 1. Sort countries by number of waves (descending), then alphabetically
country_order_tl <- vis_sample %>%
  group_by(country) %>%
  summarise(n_years = n_distinct(year), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(n_years), country)

df_timeline <- vis_sample %>%
  select(country, year) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(country = factor(country, levels = rev(country_order_tl$country)))

# 2. Split into two panels at the midpoint (left = more waves, right = fewer)
tl_levels  <- levels(df_timeline$country)
n_countries <- length(tl_levels)
mid_tl     <- ceiling(n_countries / 2)

tl_left  <- df_timeline %>%
  filter(country %in% tl_levels[(mid_tl + 1):n_countries]) %>%
  mutate(country = droplevels(country))

tl_right <- df_timeline %>%
  filter(country %in% tl_levels[1:mid_tl]) %>%
  mutate(country = droplevels(country))

# 3. Theme
timeline_theme <- function() {
  theme_minimal(base_size = 10, base_family = "serif") +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey96", linewidth = 0.2),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey98"),
    axis.title.y       = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 9, family = "serif"),
    axis.text.x        = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7.5, family = "serif"),
    axis.title.x       = element_text(size = 11, face = "italic", family = "serif"),
    legend.position    = "none"
  )
}

# 4. Build panels
tl_p1 <- ggplot(tl_left, aes(x = year, y = country)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = country), color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(color = "#D94111", size = 1.8, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1990, 2024, by = 2)) +
  labs(x = NULL) +
  timeline_theme()

tl_p2 <- ggplot(tl_right, aes(x = year, y = country)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = country), color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(color = "#D94111", size = 1.8, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1990, 2024, by = 2)) +
  labs(x = NULL) +
  timeline_theme()

# 5. Combine and display
final_timeline <- (tl_p1 | tl_p2)
final_timeline

ggsave("figures/timeline_waves.pdf", plot = final_timeline,
       device = "pdf", width = 11, height = 9, units = "in")
```

# Models

```{r model-setup}
library(lme4)
library(modelsummary)

# ── Custom glance so modelsummary reports country-year count ──────────────────
# lme4 stores the random-effect grouping factor in the "flist" slot. I extract the number of levels from (1|country:year).
glance_custom.lmerMod <- function(x, ...) {
  flist <- lme4::getME(x, "flist")
  n_cy  <- if ("country:year" %in% names(flist))
              length(levels(flist[["country:year"]]))
            else NA_integer_
  data.frame(n_country_year = n_cy)
}

# GOF rows shown in every table
gof_custom <- tibble::tribble(
  ~raw,              ~clean,             ~fmt,
  "nobs",            "N (respondents)",  0,
  "n_country_year",  "Country-years",    0,
  "r2.marginal",     "R² (marginal)",    3,
  "r2.conditional",  "R² (conditional)", 3,
  "aic",             "AIC",              1
)

# ── Derive z-scored macro variables not yet in final_sample_data ──────────────
# These are computed here (not in the joint_data pipeline) because they depend on the final analytical sample composition after all filters are applied.
final_sample_data <- final_sample_data %>%
  mutate(
    log_gdp_capita_lag_z = as.numeric(scale(log_gdp_capita_lag)),
    log_misery_lag_z     = as.numeric(scale(log_misery_lag)),
    cso_repression_z     = as.numeric(scale(cso_repression))
  )

# ── Shared formula building blocks (used by all model sections) ───────────────
# M1: bare (Gend Rep ratio only)
# M2: + interaction with egalitarianism (no controls)
# M3: + individual-level controls
# M4: + all country-year controls (macro + window-matched violence/protest + timing)

# Individual: quadratic age, education, income, marital status, employment
# Macro: freedom of expression, lagged GDP, lagged misery index, GDP growth, civil society repression (structural organisational capacity)
# Window CY: general violence + general protest (window-matched, added in loop)
# Timing: fieldwork duration (CY-level), days since FW start (respondent-level, exact-date only)

# Note on CSO repression: v2csreprss (VDEM) measures institutional constraints on civil society — distinct from log_non_gbv_st (event-based contemporaneous violence).
# Correlation between the two = -0.443; included to separate the GBV-specific mobilisation pathway from general organisational capacity suppression.

ctrl_indiv <- paste(
  "age + I(age^2) + edu_recoded + income +",
  "marital_status_binary + employment_status_binary"
)

ctrl_macro <- "freexp_altinf_z + log_gdp_capita_lag_z + log_misery_lag_z + growth_lag_z + cso_repression_z"

time_c <- "fieldwork_days_z + days_since_fw_start_z"
re     <- "(1 | country:year)"

# Primary specification: fwmid strategy, rolling windows only

windows_fwmid     <- c("roll180", "roll365", "roll730")
win_label_fwmid   <- c("Roll-180", "Roll-365", "Roll-730")

# Robustness: exact-date strategy, three rolling windows (mirrors fwmid)

windows_exact     <- c("roll180", "roll365", "roll730")
win_label_exact   <- c("Roll-180", "Roll-365", "Roll-730")

# Keep 'windows' and 'win_label' as aliases to fwmid for backward compatibility

windows   <- windows_fwmid
win_label <- win_label_fwmid

dvs      <- c("activism_high_final")
```

## Primary Specification: Structural Ambient (Fieldwork-Midpoint)

The primary empirical strategy uses the **fieldwork midpoint** (`midpoint_fw`) as a common anchor date for all respondents within a country-wave, producing a gendered repression ratio exposure measure that is constant within country-years. Identification therefore comes entirely from **between-country-year** variation in the ambient level of gendered repression — whether country-waves characterised by higher women-directed violence exposure produce systematically different male mobilisation, net of individual and country-year controls.

This strategy is preferred on three grounds. First, variance decomposition shows that 91.4% of the variance in the individually-anchored Gend Rep ratio lies between country-years rather than within them (ICC = 0.914), confirming that between-CY variation is the dominant source of identifying signal regardless of anchoring choice. Second, 66.7% of exact-date country-years recorded no women-directed violence event during the fieldwork period, meaning within-wave variation in the individually-anchored ratio reflects fluctuations in general violence (the denominator) rather than changes in women-directed violene — measurement noise rather than genuine exposure variation. Third, the structural ambient strategy aligns with the theoretical argument: the mobilising signal of gendered repression is expected to operate through sustained societal exposure and social interpretation, not through direct individual witness of specific events.

Four nested specifications are estimated per window (Roll-180, Roll-365, Roll-730). The dependent variable is **`activism_high_final`** (high-risk mobilisation: strikes + demonstrations).

| Model | Specification |
|-------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|
| M1 | Gend rep ratio + `(1\|country:year)` |
| M2 | Gend rep ratio × Egalitarianism + `(1\|country:year)` |
| M3 | M2 + individual controls (age², education, income, marital status, employment) |
| M4 | M3 + macro controls (freedom of expression, GDP, misery, growth, CSO repression) + window-matched general violence & protest + fieldwork timing |

```{r fwmid-sample}
# ── Fieldwork-midpoint sample ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
# All men in final_sample_data; no exact-date filter needed.
fwmid_data <- final_sample_data

cat("Fieldwork-midpoint sample\n")
cat("  N respondents  :", nrow(fwmid_data), "\n")
cat("  Country-years  :", n_distinct(paste(fwmid_data$country, fwmid_data$year)), "\n")
cat("  N with DV      :", sum(!is.na(fwmid_data$activism_high_final)), "\n")

# Verify coverage for fwmid windows
fwmid_coverage <- fwmid_data %>%
  group_by(country, year) %>%
  summarise(
    has_r180 = any(!is.na(gbv_ratio_fwmid_roll180_z)),
    has_r365 = any(!is.na(gbv_ratio_fwmid_roll365_z)),
    has_r730 = any(!is.na(gbv_ratio_fwmid_roll730_z)),
    .groups  = "drop"
  )

cat("\nCountry-years with valid fwmid exposure by window:\n")
fwmid_coverage %>%
  summarise(across(starts_with("has_"), sum)) %>%
  print()
```

```{r fwmid-models}
# ── Run all fwmid models ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Models stored as: models_fwmid[["<dv>_<window>_m<1-4>"]]

# NOTE: fwmid models use a TRIMMED timing block (time_c_fw).
# days_since_fw_start_z is individual-level and NA for respondents without an exact S012 date. Including it would silently restrict the sample to ~57 CY, collapsing back to the exact-date sample.

time_c_fw <- "fieldwork_days_z"

models_fwmid <- list()

for (dv in dvs) {
  for (w in windows_fwmid) {
    gv      <- paste0("gbv_ratio_fwmid_", w, "_z")
    gv_w    <- paste0("log_non_gbv_st_fwmid_", w, "_z + I(log_non_gbv_st_fwmid_", w, "_z^2) + log_gen_prot_fwmid_", w, "_z")
    ctrl_cy <- paste(ctrl_macro, "+", gv_w, "+", time_c_fw)
    key     <- paste(dv, w, sep = "_")

    f1 <- paste(dv, "~", gv,                                                         "+", re)
    f2 <- paste(dv, "~", gv, "* gender_norms_z +",                                        re)
    f3 <- paste(dv, "~", gv, "* gender_norms_z +", ctrl_indiv, "+",                       re)
    f4 <- paste(dv, "~", gv, "* gender_norms_z +", ctrl_indiv, "+", ctrl_cy, "+",        re)

    # Restrict all models to M4 complete cases so N is constant across M1–M4
    m4_vars  <- c(dv, all.vars(as.formula(paste("~", gv, "* gender_norms_z +",
                                                  ctrl_indiv, "+", ctrl_cy))))
    data_bal <- fwmid_data[complete.cases(fwmid_data[, intersect(m4_vars, names(fwmid_data))]), ]

    models_fwmid[[paste0(key, "_m1")]] <- lmer(as.formula(f1), data = data_bal, REML = FALSE)
    models_fwmid[[paste0(key, "_m2")]] <- lmer(as.formula(f2), data = data_bal, REML = FALSE)
    models_fwmid[[paste0(key, "_m3")]] <- lmer(as.formula(f3), data = data_bal, REML = FALSE)
    models_fwmid[[paste0(key, "_m4")]] <- lmer(as.formula(f4), data = data_bal, REML = FALSE)
  }
}

cat("Models fitted:", length(models_fwmid), "\n")

# Find all list elements where the name ends with "_m4"
m4_models_mid <- models_fwmid[grep("_m4$", names(models_fwmid))]

# View the regression table for Model 4 across all windows
texreg::screenreg(m4_models_mid)
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Robustness Specification: Interview-Date-Anchored

The interview-date-anchored specification assigns each respondent a gendered repression ratio computed over the rolling window ending on their individual verified interview date (S012). In principle this allows within-country-year identification: respondents interviewed during higher-women directed violence periods are compared to contemporaries in the same country-year who were interviewed during lower-GBV periods, with the `(1|country:year)` random effect absorbing all between-wave confounding.

In practice, three empirical findings limit the inferential value of this strategy relative to the structural ambient approach. First, the ICC of the individually-anchored Gend Rep ratio is 0.914, meaning 91.4% of its variance lies between country-years — the random effect absorbs the mean DV for each CY, but the fixed-effect estimate of Gend Rep ratio still draws overwhelmingly on between-CY variation, not within-wave timing. Second, within-wave ratio variation in those CYs is purely denominator-driven (general violence fluctuating), not genuine GBV exposure change. These models are therefore retained as a robustness check on measurement sensitivity. 

| Model | Specification |
|-------------|-----------------------------------------------------------|
| M1 | Gend rep ratio + `(1\|country:year)` |
| M2 | Gend rep ratio × Egalitarianism + `(1\|country:year)` |
| M3 | M2 + individual controls |
| M4 | M3 + macro controls + window-matched violence & protest + fieldwork timing |

```{r exact-sample}
# ── Exact-date sample ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
exact_data <- final_sample_data %>% filter(has_exact_date)

# Common exact-date sample: CYs with valid roll-730 exact-date exposure. Mirrors cy_r730 for fwmid — holds sample constant across windows.

  group_by(country, year) %>%
  filter(any(!is.na(gbv_ratio_exact_roll730_z))) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("Exact-date sample (full):", nrow(exact_data), "respondents,",
    n_distinct(paste(exact_data$country, exact_data$year)), "CYs\n")
cat("Exact-date common sample:", nrow(cy_r730_exact), "respondents,",
    n_distinct(paste(cy_r730_exact$country, cy_r730_exact$year)), "CYs\n")
```

```{r exact-models}
# ── Run all exact-date models (common roll-730 sample) ────────────────────────
# Uses cy_r730_exact so all three windows run on the same CYs.
# M4 complete-case restriction keeps N constant across M1–M4.
models_exact <- list()

for (dv in dvs) {
  for (w in windows_exact) {
    gv      <- paste0("gbv_ratio_exact_", w, "_z")
    gv_w    <- paste0("log_non_gbv_st_exact_", w, "_z + I(log_non_gbv_st_exact_", w, "_z^2) + log_gen_prot_exact_", w, "_z")
    ctrl_cy <- paste(ctrl_macro, "+", gv_w, "+", time_c)
    key     <- paste(dv, w, sep = "_")

    f1 <- paste(dv, "~", gv,                                                         "+", re)
    f2 <- paste(dv, "~", gv, "* gender_norms_z +",                                        re)
    f3 <- paste(dv, "~", gv, "* gender_norms_z +", ctrl_indiv, "+",                       re)
    f4 <- paste(dv, "~", gv, "* gender_norms_z +", ctrl_indiv, "+", ctrl_cy, "+",        re)

    m4_vars  <- c(dv, all.vars(as.formula(paste("~", gv, "* gender_norms_z +",
                                                  ctrl_indiv, "+", ctrl_cy))))
    data_bal <- cy_r730_exact[complete.cases(
      cy_r730_exact[, intersect(m4_vars, names(cy_r730_exact))]), ]

    models_exact[[paste0(key, "_m1")]] <- lmer(as.formula(f1), data = data_bal, REML = FALSE)
    models_exact[[paste0(key, "_m2")]] <- lmer(as.formula(f2), data = data_bal, REML = FALSE)
    models_exact[[paste0(key, "_m3")]] <- lmer(as.formula(f3), data = data_bal, REML = FALSE)
    models_exact[[paste0(key, "_m4")]] <- lmer(as.formula(f4), data = data_bal, REML = FALSE)
  }
}

cat("Models fitted:", length(models_exact), "\n")

library(purrr)
library(stringr)

# Find all list elements where the name ends with "_m4"
m4_models <- models_exact[grep("_m4$", names(models_exact))]

# View the regression table for Model 4 across all windows
texreg::screenreg(m4_models)

```

::: callout-note
**Why is the exact-date sample smaller?** `exact_data` filters `final_sample_data` to respondents with a verified S012 interview date (roughly 55–65% of WVS Wave 7 respondents per country). Additional listwise deletion on `activism_high_final` (the strike item was not administered in some African country-years) and on covariates reduces the sample further to \~57 country-years.
:::

# Main Results

## Main Results

Two tables are presented. **Table 1** shows the four nested model specifications (M1–M4) for Roll-180 — the shortest rolling window, capturing recent gend rep salience — displaying only the three theoretically central estimates (gend rep ratio, egalitarianism, their interaction) with control inclusion indicated by checkmarks. This allows assessment of how estimates of interest behave as controls are progressively added. **Table 2** then shows the M4 (full controls) estimates across all three rolling windows simultaneously, demonstrating the temporal sensitivity of effects. Full coefficient tables for all windows appear in Appendix A; the model-building progression appears in Appendix C.

```{r tbl-main-results, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(modelsummary)
library(kableExtra)

# ── Helper retained for LaTeX export and Appendix C (M1–M4 build table) ──────
make_build_table <- function(model_list, strategy, window = "roll180",
                             caption_txt, output = "default") {
  gv <- paste0("gbv_ratio_", strategy, "_", window, "_z")
  mods <- list(
    "M1" = model_list[[paste0("activism_high_final_", window, "_m1")]],
    "M2" = model_list[[paste0("activism_high_final_", window, "_m2")]],
    "M3" = model_list[[paste0("activism_high_final_", window, "_m3")]],
    "M4" = model_list[[paste0("activism_high_final_", window, "_m4")]]
  )
  cm <- c(setNames(list("Gend. Repression (z)"), gv),
          list("gender_norms_z" = "Egalitarianism (z)"))
  cm[[paste0(gv, ":gender_norms_z")]] <- "Gend. Repression × Egalitarianism"
  cm[[paste0("gender_norms_z:", gv)]] <- "Gend. Repression × Egalitarianism"
  ctrl_rows <- tribble(
    ~term,                         ~M1, ~M2,  ~M3,  ~M4,
    "Individual controls",         "",  "",   "✓",  "✓",
    "Macro controls",              "",  "",   "",   "✓",
    "CSO repression",              "",  "",   "",   "✓",
    "General violence & protest",  "",  "",   "",   "✓",
    "Fieldwork timing",            "",  "",   "",   "✓"
  )
  attr(ctrl_rows, "position") <- 7:11
  modelsummary(mods, coef_map = cm, add_rows = ctrl_rows,
               stars = c("+" = .1, "*" = .05, "**" = .01, "***" = .001),
               gof_map = gof_custom, title = caption_txt, output = output,
               notes = paste("Standard errors in parentheses.",
                             "Outcome: high-risk mobilisation.",
                             "Random intercept (1|country:year) in all models.",
                             "Full coefficient tables in Appendix A."))
}

# ── Table 1: Three-window comparison (M4, structural ambient) ─────────────────
# Columns = Roll-180 / Roll-365 / Roll-730 — all M4 full controls. Since I am agnostic on which window best captures the mobilising signal, all three are shown simultaneously as a temporal sensitivity ladder. Coefficients from different windows are mapped to shared row labels so that gend rep ratio, egalitarianism , and their interaction each occupy a single row.
make_three_window_table <- function(model_list, strategy, caption_txt,
                                    output = "default") {
  wins   <- c("roll180", "roll365", "roll730")
  labels <- c("Roll-180", "Roll-365", "Roll-730")

  mods <- setNames(
    lapply(wins, function(w)
      model_list[[paste0("activism_high_final_", w, "_m4")]]),
    labels
  )

  # Map all three GBV variable names to the same display label
  cm <- list("gender_norms_z" = "Egalitarianism (z)")
  for (w in wins) {
    gv  <- paste0("gbv_ratio_", strategy, "_", w, "_z")
    cm[[gv]]                              <- "Gend. Repression (z)"
    cm[[paste0(gv, ":gender_norms_z")]]  <- "Gend. Repression × Egalitarianism"
    cm[[paste0("gender_norms_z:", gv)]]  <- "Gend. Repression × Egalitarianism"
  }

  # All columns are M4: all controls present
  ctrl_rows <- tribble(
    ~term,                         ~`Roll-180`, ~`Roll-365`, ~`Roll-730`,
    "Individual controls",         "✓",         "✓",         "✓",
    "Macro controls",              "✓",         "✓",         "✓",
    "CSO repression",              "✓",         "✓",         "✓",
    "General violence & protest",  "✓",         "✓",         "✓",
    "Fieldwork timing",            "✓",         "✓",         "✓"
  )
  attr(ctrl_rows, "position") <- 7:11

  modelsummary(
    mods,
    coef_map  = cm,
    add_rows  = ctrl_rows,
    stars = c("+" = .1, "*" = .05, "**" = .01, "***" = .001),
    gof_map   = gof_custom,
    title     = caption_txt,
    output    = output,
    notes     = paste(
      "Standard errors in parentheses.",
      "Outcome: high-risk mobilisation (demonstrations + strikes).",
      "All models M4: individual controls, macro controls, Society Repression,",
      "window-matched general violence and protest, fieldwork timing.",
      "Random intercept (1|country:year). Full tables in Appendix A."
    )
  )
}

# ── Table 1: Model-building progression (M1–M4, Roll-180) ────────────────────
make_build_table(
  models_fwmid, "fwmid", "roll180",
  "Table 1: High-risk mobilisation — Model building, Roll-180 (structural ambient)"
)

# ── Table 2: Window sensitivity (M4, Roll-180 / Roll-365 / Roll-730) ──────────
make_three_window_table(
  models_fwmid, "fwmid",
  "Table 2: High-risk mobilisation — M4, all windows (structural ambient)"
)
```

## Robustness: Common-Sample Window Comparison (61 Country-Years)

Table 3 re-estimates M4 for all three rolling windows on the common intersection sample — the 61 country-years for which the most restrictive (730-day) window yields valid GBV exposure. By holding the sample constant, any differences across columns reflect temporal window choice rather than sample composition. This tests whether the results in Table 2 are sensitive to the inclusion of country-years with shorter ACLED coverage histories.

```{r tbl-robustness-common-sample, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ── Restrict to 61 CYs with valid roll-730 coverage ──────────────────────────
cy_r730 <- fwmid_data %>%
  group_by(country, year) %>%
  filter(any(!is.na(gbv_ratio_fwmid_roll730_z))) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("Common-sample (roll-730 restriction)\n")
cat("  N respondents :", nrow(cy_r730), "\n")
cat("  Country-years :", n_distinct(paste(cy_r730$country, cy_r730$year)), "\n")

# ── Run M4 for all three windows on the common sample ─────────────────────────
models_r730_common <- list()

for (w in windows_fwmid) {
  gv      <- paste0("gbv_ratio_fwmid_", w, "_z")
  gv_w    <- paste0("log_non_gbv_st_fwmid_", w, "_z + I(log_non_gbv_st_fwmid_", w, "_z^2) + log_gen_prot_fwmid_", w, "_z")
  ctrl_cy <- paste(ctrl_macro, "+", gv_w, "+", time_c_fw)
  f4 <- paste("activism_high_final ~", gv, "* gender_norms_z +",
               ctrl_indiv, "+", ctrl_cy, "+", re)
  models_r730_common[[paste0("activism_high_final_", w, "_m4")]] <-
    lmer(as.formula(f4), data = cy_r730, REML = FALSE)
}

# ── Table 3: M4, all windows, common 61-CY sample ─────────────────────────────
make_three_window_table(
  models_r730_common, "fwmid",
  "Table 3: High-risk mobilisation — M4, all windows, common sample (61 CYs)"
)
```

## Marginal Effects and Predicted Values

```{r marginal-effects, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# UNIFIED: Marginal Effects and Predicted Values (Roll-180 and all windows)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(patchwork)

# ── Theme (consistent across all plots) ───────────────────────────────────────
# ── Theme (Updated with y-axis title margin) ──────────────────────────────────
theme_main <- theme_minimal(base_family = "serif", base_size = 15) +
  theme(
    # Added margin(r = 12) to push the title to the left, away from the numbers
    axis.title.y         = element_text(size = 17, face = "plain", margin = margin(r = 12)),
    axis.title.x         = element_text(size = 17, face = "plain", margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.text            = element_text(size = 15),
    legend.title         = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
    legend.text          = element_text(size = 14),
    legend.position      = "bottom",
    strip.text           = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    strip.background     = element_rect(fill = "grey95", color = NA),
    panel.grid.minor     = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y   = element_line(color = "grey95", linewidth = 0.3),
    panel.grid.major.x   = element_blank(),
    plot.title           = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0), # Slightly smaller title text to prevent overlaps
    plot.subtitle        = element_text(size = 14, color = "grey50", hjust = 0),
    plot.caption         = element_text(size = 12, color = "grey50", hjust = 0)
  )

# ── Colour palette ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
col_patriarchal  <- "#821115"   # -1.5 SD egalitarianism
col_egalitarian  <- "#2b8cbe"   # +1.5 SD egalitarianism
col_ame          <- "#4C72B0"   # AME line
col_band         <- "grey75"    # CI ribbon

# ── Helper 1: Extract coefficients and vcov ──────────────────────────────────
get_coefs <- function(model, ratio_var) {
  b   <- fixef(model)
  v   <- as.matrix(vcov(model))
  int <- paste0(ratio_var, ":gender_norms_z")
  if (!int %in% names(b)) int <- paste0("gender_norms_z:", ratio_var)
  list(
    b_ratio = b[[ratio_var]],
    b_int   = b[[int]],
    var_ratio = v[ratio_var, ratio_var],
    var_int   = v[int, int],
    cov_ri    = v[ratio_var, int]
  )
}

# ── Helper 2: Compute AME ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
compute_ame <- function(model, ratio_var, data, window_label) {
  coefs  <- get_coefs(model, ratio_var)
  eg_seq <- seq(
    min(data$gender_norms_z, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(data$gender_norms_z, na.rm = TRUE),
    length.out = 100
  )
  ame <- coefs$b_ratio + coefs$b_int * eg_seq
  se  <- sqrt(
    coefs$var_ratio +
    eg_seq^2 * coefs$var_int +
    2 * eg_seq * coefs$cov_ri
  )
  tibble(
    gender_norms_z = eg_seq,
    ame            = ame,
    lower          = ame - 1.96 * se,
    upper          = ame + 1.96 * se,
    window         = window_label
  )
}

# ── Helper 3: Compute predicted values ────────────────────────────────────────
compute_predictions <- function(model, ratio_var, data, window_label) {
  b      <- fixef(model)
  v      <- as.matrix(vcov(model))
  int    <- paste0(ratio_var, ":gender_norms_z")
  if (!int %in% names(b)) int <- paste0("gender_norms_z:", ratio_var)

  ratio_seq <- seq(
    min(data[[ratio_var]], na.rm = TRUE),
    max(data[[ratio_var]], na.rm = TRUE),
    length.out = 100
  )

  mean_pred <- mean(predict(model, re.form = NA), na.rm = TRUE)
  ratio_mean <- mean(data[[ratio_var]], na.rm = TRUE)
  norms_mean <- mean(data$gender_norms_z, na.rm = TRUE)

  intercept_eff <- mean_pred -
    b[[ratio_var]] * ratio_mean -
    b[["gender_norms_z"]] * norms_mean -
    b[[int]] * ratio_mean * norms_mean

  pmap_dfr(
    list(
      eg_val = c(-1.5, 1.5),
      label  = c("Patriarchal (-1.5 SD)", "Egalitarian (+1.5 SD)")
    ),
    function(eg_val, label) {
      pred <- intercept_eff +
        b[[ratio_var]] * ratio_seq +
        b[["gender_norms_z"]] * eg_val +
        b[[int]] * ratio_seq * eg_val

      se <- sqrt(
        v[ratio_var, ratio_var] * ratio_seq^2 +
        v[int, int] * (ratio_seq * eg_val)^2 +
        2 * v[ratio_var, int] * ratio_seq * ratio_seq * eg_val
      )

      tibble(
        ratio_val      = ratio_seq,
        predicted      = pred,
        conf.low       = pred - 1.96 * se,
        conf.high      = pred + 1.96 * se,
        group          = label,
        window         = window_label
      )
    }
  )
}

# ── Compute all windows ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ame_all <- bind_rows(
  compute_ame(models_fwmid[["activism_high_final_roll180_m4"]],
              "gbv_ratio_fwmid_roll180_z", fwmid_data, "Roll-180"),
  compute_ame(models_fwmid[["activism_high_final_roll365_m4"]],
              "gbv_ratio_fwmid_roll365_z", fwmid_data, "Roll-365"),
  compute_ame(models_fwmid[["activism_high_final_roll730_m4"]],
              "gbv_ratio_fwmid_roll730_z", fwmid_data, "Roll-730")
) %>%
  mutate(window = factor(window, levels = c("Roll-180", "Roll-365", "Roll-730")))

pred_all <- bind_rows(
  compute_predictions(models_fwmid[["activism_high_final_roll180_m4"]],
                      "gbv_ratio_fwmid_roll180_z", fwmid_data, "Roll-180"),
  compute_predictions(models_fwmid[["activism_high_final_roll365_m4"]],
                      "gbv_ratio_fwmid_roll365_z", fwmid_data, "Roll-365"),
  compute_predictions(models_fwmid[["activism_high_final_roll730_m4"]],
                      "gbv_ratio_fwmid_roll730_z", fwmid_data, "Roll-730")
) %>%
  mutate(
    window = factor(window, levels = c("Roll-180", "Roll-365", "Roll-730")),
    group  = factor(group,  levels = c("Patriarchal (-1.5 SD)", "Egalitarian (+1.5 SD)"))
  )
```

## Coefficient Plot

```{r coef-plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=7, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(broom.mixed)

windows_key <- c("roll180", "roll365", "roll730")
windows_lab <- c("Roll-180", "Roll-365", "Roll-730")

# ── Extract Gend Rep ratio and GBV×Norms from all M4 models ───────────────────────
extract_coefs <- function(model_list, strategy, dv_name, dv_label) {
  purrr::map_dfr(seq_along(windows_key), function(i) {
    w     <- windows_key[i]
    gv    <- paste0("gbv_ratio_", strategy, "_", w, "_z")
    model <- model_list[[paste0(dv_name, "_", w, "_m4")]]
    if (is.null(model)) return(NULL)

    td <- broom.mixed::tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE, conf.method = "Wald") %>%
      filter(effect == "fixed") %>%
      mutate(p.value = 2 * pnorm(abs(statistic), lower.tail = FALSE))

    # Gend Rep ratio row
    gbv_row   <- filter(td, term == gv)
    # Egalitarianism main effect
    norm_row  <- filter(td, term == "gender_norms_z")
    # Interaction — R may order either way
    int_row   <- filter(td, grepl(paste0(gv, ":gender_norms_z|gender_norms_z:", gv), term))

    bind_rows(
      if (nrow(gbv_row) > 0) tibble(
        window    = windows_lab[i],
        term      = "Gend. Repression",
        estimate  = gbv_row$estimate,
        conf.low  = gbv_row$conf.low,
        conf.high = gbv_row$conf.high,
        p.value   = gbv_row$p.value,
        strategy  = strategy,
        dv        = dv_label
      ),
      if (nrow(norm_row) > 0) tibble(
        window    = windows_lab[i],
        term      = "Egalitarianism",
        estimate  = norm_row$estimate[1],
        conf.low  = norm_row$conf.low[1],
        conf.high = norm_row$conf.high[1],
        p.value   = norm_row$p.value[1],
        strategy  = strategy,
        dv        = dv_label
      ),
      if (nrow(int_row) > 0) tibble(
        window    = windows_lab[i],
        term      = "Gend. Repression × Egalitarianism",
        estimate  = int_row$estimate[1],
        conf.low  = int_row$conf.low[1],
        conf.high = int_row$conf.high[1],
        p.value   = int_row$p.value[1],
        strategy  = strategy,
        dv        = dv_label
      )
    )
  })
}

# Restricted common sample (61 CYs): ensures window comparison is not confounded by sample composition — same country-years across all three windows.
coef_data <- bind_rows(
  extract_coefs(models_r730_common, "fwmid", "activism_high_final", "High-risk")
) %>%
  mutate(
    window = factor(window, levels = rev(windows_lab)),
    term   = factor(term, levels = c(
      "Gend. Repression",
      "Egalitarianism",
      "Gend. Repression × Egalitarianism"
    )),
    strategy = "Structural ambient",
    sig      = p.value < 0.05
  )

# ── Plot ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ggplot(coef_data,
       aes(x = estimate, y = window, alpha = sig)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
  geom_pointrange(
    aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high),
    colour    = "#E41A1C",
    linewidth = 0.7,
    size      = 0.6
  ) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 1, `FALSE` = 0.30), guide = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~ term, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "serif", base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position   = "none",
    panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    strip.text        = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x      = element_text(size = 13, margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.text.x       = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y       = element_text(size = 12),
    strip.background  = element_rect(fill = "grey95", colour = NA),
    panel.spacing     = unit(1.5, "lines")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Coefficient estimate (95% CI)",
    y = NULL
  )

ggsave("coef_plot_main.pdf", width = 11, height = 5, device = "pdf")
```

```{r latex-export, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
)
```
