## Appendix C: Full Model-Building Progression (M1–M4, Roll-180)

Full coefficient tables showing all predictors across the four nested model specifications for Roll-180.

```{r appendix-c-roll180, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ── Full-coefficient M1–M4 table for Roll-180 ────────────────────────────────
# Shows all predictors across M1 → M2 → M3 → M4 for the primary window

make_full_build_table <- function(model_list, strategy, window,
                                  caption_txt, output = "default") {
  gv  <- paste0("gbv_ratio_", strategy, "_", window, "_z")
  gvw <- paste0("log_non_gbv_st_", strategy, "_", window, "_z")
  gpw <- paste0("log_gen_prot_",   strategy, "_", window, "_z")

  mods <- list(
    "M1" = model_list[[paste0("activism_high_final_", window, "_m1")]],
    "M2" = model_list[[paste0("activism_high_final_", window, "_m2")]],
    "M3" = model_list[[paste0("activism_high_final_", window, "_m3")]],
    "M4" = model_list[[paste0("activism_high_final_", window, "_m4")]]
  )

  cm <- c(
    setNames(c("Gend. Repression (z)"),              gv),
    "gender_norms_z"                               = "Egalitarianism (z)",
    setNames(c("Gend. Repression × Egalitarianism"),
             paste0(gv, ":gender_norms_z")),
    setNames(c("Gend. Repression × Egalitarianism"),
             paste0("gender_norms_z:", gv)),
    "age"                                          = "Age",
    "I(age^2)"                                     = "Age²",
    "edu_recodedmiddle"                            = "Education: middle",
    "edu_recodedupper"                             = "Education: upper",
    "income"                                       = "Income",
    "marital_status_binary"                        = "Married",
    "employment_status_binary"                     = "Employed",
    "freexp_altinf_z"                              = "Freedom of Expression (z)",
    "log_gdp_capita_lag_z"                         = "Log GDP p.c. (lag, z)",
    "log_misery_lag_z"                             = "Misery Index (lag, z)",
    "growth_lag_z"                                 = "GDP Growth (lag, z)",
    "cso_repression_z"                             = "Society Repression (z)",
    setNames(c("Log General Violence (z)"),        gvw),
    setNames(c("Log General Violence² (z)"),       paste0("I(", gvw, "^2)")),
    setNames(c("Log General Protest (z)"),         gpw),
    "fieldwork_days_z"                             = "Fieldwork Duration (z)",
    "days_since_fw_start_z"                        = "Days since FW Start (z)"
  )

  modelsummary(
    mods,
    coef_map = cm,
    stars = c("+" = .1, "*" = .05, "**" = .01, "***" = .001),
    gof_map  = gof_custom,
    title    = caption_txt,
    output   = output,
    notes    = paste(
      "Standard errors in parentheses.",
      "Outcome: high-risk mobilisation (demonstrations + strikes).",
      "Random intercept (1|country:year) in all models."
    )
  )
}

# Generate table for Roll-180 (primary window)
make_full_build_table(
  models_fwmid, "fwmid", "roll180",
  "Appendix C: Full Model-Building Progression — Roll-180 (6 months), Structural Ambient (M1–M4)"
)
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Robustness Analyses

The following robustness checks probe the sensitivity of the main results to specification choices, sample composition, and modelling assumptions. Each section states what is being tested and what the results imply.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## R1 — Interview-Date-Anchored Specification

Full coefficient tables for the interview-date-anchored specification appear in Appendix B, estimated on the common intersection sample (CYs with valid roll-730 exact-date exposure) so all three windows are directly comparable. As discussed in the model setup section, the divergent interaction sign under this anchor is attributable to within-wave anchor noise rather than a substantive finding — 77.2% of exact-date CYs recorded no GBV event during fieldwork, meaning within-wave ratio variation is denominator-driven rather than genuine exposure change. The coefficient plot below shows how estimates behave across windows under this alternative anchoring strategy.

```{r coef-plot-exact, fig.width=11, fig.height=5, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(broom.mixed)

windows_key_ex <- c("roll180", "roll365", "roll730")
windows_lab_ex <- c("Roll-180", "Roll-365", "Roll-730")

coef_data_exact <- purrr::map_dfr(seq_along(windows_key_ex), function(i) {
  w     <- windows_key_ex[i]
  gv    <- paste0("gbv_ratio_exact_", w, "_z")
  model <- models_exact[[paste0("activism_high_final_", w, "_m4")]]
  if (is.null(model)) return(NULL)

  td <- broom.mixed::tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE, conf.method = "Wald") %>%
    filter(effect == "fixed") %>%
    mutate(p.value = 2 * pnorm(abs(statistic), lower.tail = FALSE))

  gbv_row  <- filter(td, term == gv)
  norm_row <- filter(td, term == "gender_norms_z")
  int_row  <- filter(td, grepl(paste0(gv, ":gender_norms_z|gender_norms_z:", gv), term))

  bind_rows(
    if (nrow(gbv_row)  > 0) tibble(window = windows_lab_ex[i],
      term = "Gend. Repression",
      estimate = gbv_row$estimate, conf.low = gbv_row$conf.low,
      conf.high = gbv_row$conf.high, p.value = gbv_row$p.value),
    if (nrow(norm_row) > 0) tibble(window = windows_lab_ex[i],
      term = "Egalitarianism",
      estimate = norm_row$estimate[1], conf.low = norm_row$conf.low[1],
      conf.high = norm_row$conf.high[1], p.value = norm_row$p.value[1]),
    if (nrow(int_row)  > 0) tibble(window = windows_lab_ex[i],
      term = "Gend. Repression × Egalitarianism",
      estimate = int_row$estimate[1], conf.low = int_row$conf.low[1],
      conf.high = int_row$conf.high[1], p.value = int_row$p.value[1])
  )
}) %>%
  mutate(
    window = factor(window, levels = rev(windows_lab_ex)),
    term   = factor(term, levels = c(
      "Gend. Repression", "Egalitarianism",
      "Gend. Repression × Egalitarianism")),
    sig = p.value < 0.05
  )

ggplot(coef_data_exact, aes(x = estimate, y = window, alpha = sig)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
  geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = conf.low, xmax = conf.high),
                  colour = "#377EB8", linewidth = 0.7, size = 0.6) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = 1, `FALSE` = 0.30), guide = "none") +
  facet_wrap(~ term, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "serif", base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position    = "none",
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    strip.text         = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x       = element_text(size = 13, margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.text.x        = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text.y        = element_text(size = 12),
    strip.background   = element_rect(fill = "grey95", colour = NA),
    panel.spacing      = unit(1.5, "lines")
  ) +
  labs(x = "Coefficient estimate (95% CI)", y = NULL)

ggsave("coef_plot_exact.pdf", width = 11, height = 5, device = "pdf")
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## R2 — Leave-One-Country-Out (LOCO)

For each country in the fwmid sample, all country-years belonging to that country are dropped and M4 is re-estimated. Itrack the Gend Rep ratio coefficient and the GBV × Egalitarianism interaction across two windows: **Roll-365** (reference window for Table 1) and **Roll-180** (to check whether the significant GBV main effect at that horizon is driven by a single influential country). A dot plot and summary table are produced so that any influential country can be identified.

```{r loco-setup}
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)

# ── Helper ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
run_loco <- function(data, formula_str, group_var = "country", track_coefs) {
  groups <- unique(data[[group_var]])
  map_dfr(groups, function(g) {
    d_sub <- data %>% filter(.data[[group_var]] != g)
    m     <- tryCatch(lmer(as.formula(formula_str), data = d_sub, REML = FALSE),
                      error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(m)) return(NULL)
    fe <- fixef(m); se <- sqrt(diag(vcov(m)))
    map_dfr(track_coefs, function(tc) {
      if (!tc %in% names(fe)) return(NULL)
      tibble(dropped = g, coef = tc, estimate = fe[[tc]], std_error = se[[tc]])
    })
  })
}

# ── Formula strings ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Roll-365 — reference window for Table 1
f_r365 <- paste("activism_high_final ~ gbv_ratio_fwmid_roll365_z * gender_norms_z +",
                ctrl_indiv, "+", ctrl_macro, "+",
                "log_non_gbv_st_fwmid_roll365_z + I(log_non_gbv_st_fwmid_roll365_z^2) + log_gen_prot_fwmid_roll365_z +",
                time_c_fw, "+", re)
track_r365 <- c("gbv_ratio_fwmid_roll365_z",
                "gbv_ratio_fwmid_roll365_z:gender_norms_z")

# Roll-180 — shortest window, significant GBV main effect; check for country influence
f_r180 <- paste("activism_high_final ~ gbv_ratio_fwmid_roll180_z * gender_norms_z +",
                ctrl_indiv, "+", ctrl_macro, "+",
                "log_non_gbv_st_fwmid_roll180_z + I(log_non_gbv_st_fwmid_roll180_z^2) + log_gen_prot_fwmid_roll180_z +",
                time_c_fw, "+", re)
track_r180 <- c("gbv_ratio_fwmid_roll180_z",
                "gbv_ratio_fwmid_roll180_z:gender_norms_z")

cat("LOCO setup complete. Running Roll-365 and Roll-180...\n")
```

```{r loco-run, cache=TRUE}
loco_r365 <- run_loco(fwmid_data, f_r365, track_coefs = track_r365) %>%
  mutate(window = "Roll-365")
loco_r180 <- run_loco(fwmid_data, f_r180, track_coefs = track_r180) %>%
  mutate(window = "Roll-180")

loco_all <- bind_rows(loco_r365, loco_r180) %>%
  mutate(
    coef_label = case_when(
      str_detect(coef, "gender_norms") ~ "Gend. Repression × Egalitarianism",
      TRUE                             ~ "Gend. Repression (main effect)"
    ),
    ci_lo = estimate - 1.96 * std_error,
    ci_hi = estimate + 1.96 * std_error
  )

cat("LOCO complete:", nrow(loco_all), "rows\n")
```

```{r loco-table, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ── Full LOCO table ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ref_r365_gbv <- fixef(models_fwmid[["activism_high_final_roll365_m4"]])["gbv_ratio_fwmid_roll365_z"]
ref_r365_int <- fixef(models_fwmid[["activism_high_final_roll365_m4"]])["gbv_ratio_fwmid_roll365_z:gender_norms_z"]
ref_r180_gbv <- fixef(models_fwmid[["activism_high_final_roll180_m4"]])["gbv_ratio_fwmid_roll180_z"]
ref_r180_int <- fixef(models_fwmid[["activism_high_final_roll180_m4"]])["gbv_ratio_fwmid_roll180_z:gender_norms_z"]

cat("=== LOCO: fwmid Roll-365 and Roll-180 ===\n")
cat(sprintf("Full-sample Roll-365 — GBV: %.4f | Interaction: %.4f\n",
            ref_r365_gbv, ref_r365_int))
cat(sprintf("Full-sample Roll-180 — GBV: %.4f | Interaction: %.4f\n\n",
            ref_r180_gbv, ref_r180_int))

loco_all %>%
  select(dropped, window, coef_label, estimate, std_error) %>%
  mutate(across(c(estimate, std_error), ~ round(., 4))) %>%
  arrange(window, coef_label, dropped) %>%
  print(n = 200)
```

```{r loco-plot, fig.width=10, fig.height=6, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(patchwork)

# ── Roll-180: all countries, top 5 flagged in red, names in caption ───────────
loco_r180_raw <- loco_all %>% filter(window == "Roll-180")

make_loco_panel_clean <- function(data, coef_lbl, ref_val, panel_title) {
  d <- data %>% filter(coef_label == coef_lbl)

  top5 <- d %>%
    mutate(delta = abs(estimate - ref_val)) %>%
    slice_max(delta, n = 5) %>%
    pull(dropped)

  d <- d %>%
    mutate(
      dropped = factor(dropped, levels = arrange(d, estimate)$dropped),
      label   = if_else(dropped %in% top5, as.character(dropped), NA_character_)
    )

  ggplot(d, aes(x = estimate, y = dropped)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0,       linetype = "dotted", colour = "black",   linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = ref_val, linetype = "dotted", colour = "#E41A1C", linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = ci_lo, xmax = ci_hi),
                    colour = "grey40", linewidth = 0.4, size = 0.35) +
    geom_point(data = ~ filter(., !is.na(label)),
               colour = "#E41A1C", size = 2.2) +
    labs(title = panel_title,
         x = "Coefficient estimate (95% CI)", y = NULL) +
    theme_minimal(base_family = "serif", base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      plot.title         = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", margin = margin(b = 6)),
      axis.text.y        = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.y       = element_blank(),
      axis.text.x        = element_text(size = 10),
      axis.title.x       = element_text(size = 10, margin = margin(t = 8))
    )
}

# ── Top-5 country names for caption ──────────────────────────────────────────
top5_gbv <- loco_r180_raw %>%
  filter(coef_label == "Gend. Repression (main effect)") %>%
  mutate(delta = abs(estimate - ref_r180_gbv)) %>%
  slice_max(delta, n = 5) %>%
  arrange(desc(delta)) %>%
  pull(dropped)

top5_int <- loco_r180_raw %>%
  filter(coef_label == "Gend. Repression × Egalitarianism") %>%
  mutate(delta = abs(estimate - ref_r180_int)) %>%
  slice_max(delta, n = 5) %>%
  arrange(desc(delta)) %>%
  pull(dropped)

caption_txt <- paste0(
  "Red dotted line = full-sample estimate (Roll-180, M4). ",
  "Red dots = 5 most influential countries.\n",
  "Gend. Repression: ", paste(top5_gbv, collapse = ", "), ". ",
  "Interaction: ",      paste(top5_int, collapse = ", "), "."
)

# ── Build and display ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
p_gbv <- make_loco_panel_clean(loco_r180_raw,
                                "Gend. Repression (main effect)",
                                ref_r180_gbv,
                                "Gendered Repression Ratio")

p_int <- make_loco_panel_clean(loco_r180_raw,
                                "Gend. Repression × Egalitarianism",
                                ref_r180_int,
                                "Gendered Repression × Egalitarianism")

p_gbv + p_int +
  plot_annotation(
  #  caption = caption_txt,
    theme   = theme(plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, family = "serif",
                                                colour = "grey30", hjust = 0))
  )

ggsave("figures/loco_plot.pdf", width = 10, height = 6, device = "pdf")
```

# Reviewer Materials: Low-Risk Mobilisation (Petitions + Boycotts)

Low-risk mobilisation is defined as the Kwak-weighted score over petitions and boycotts. It correlates r = 0.97 with high-risk mobilisation; the two-factor CFA is statistically preferred but results are substantively near-identical across both outcomes. Only the structural ambient (fieldwork-midpoint) strategy is presented here, on the common 61-CY sample (roll-730 restriction), for direct comparability with the main high-risk results.

```{r reviewer-low-models, cache=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ── Fit low-risk M4 models — fwmid, common 61-CY sample ──────────────────────
models_low_fwmid <- list()
for (w in windows) {
  gv      <- paste0("gbv_ratio_fwmid_", w, "_z")
  gv_w    <- paste0("log_non_gbv_st_fwmid_", w, "_z + I(log_non_gbv_st_fwmid_", w, "_z^2) + log_gen_prot_fwmid_", w, "_z")
  ctrl_cy <- paste(ctrl_macro, "+", gv_w, "+", time_c_fw)

  f4      <- paste("activism_low_final ~", gv, "* gender_norms_z +",
                   ctrl_indiv, "+", ctrl_cy, "+", re)
  m4_vars  <- c("activism_low_final",
                all.vars(as.formula(paste("~", gv, "* gender_norms_z +",
                                          ctrl_indiv, "+", ctrl_cy))))
  data_bal <- cy_r730[complete.cases(
    cy_r730[, intersect(m4_vars, names(cy_r730))]), ]

  models_low_fwmid[[paste0("low_", w, "_m4")]] <-
    lmer(as.formula(f4), data = data_bal, REML = FALSE)
}

cat("Low-risk fwmid models fitted:", length(models_low_fwmid), "\n")
```

## Reviewer Table R1: Low-Risk — All Windows, Structural Ambient (M4, 61 CYs)

```{r reviewer-app-low-fwmid, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
rev_low_fwmid <- lapply(windows, function(w) models_low_fwmid[[paste0("low_", w, "_m4")]])
names(rev_low_fwmid) <- win_label

modelsummary(
  rev_low_fwmid,
  coef_map = coef_map_fwmid_all,
  stars = c("+" = .1, "*" = .05, "**" = .01, "***" = .001),
  gof_map  = gof_custom,
  title    = "Reviewer Table R1: Low-risk mobilisation — Structural ambient, all windows, common sample (61 CYs, M4)"
)
```

# DiD: Quasi-Random GBV Events During Fieldwork

The DiD strategy exploits within-survey temporal variation. Treatment is defined as the *first* women-directed violent event recorded during a country-year's fieldwork window. Respondents interviewed after that date are "post-event"; those before are "pre-event". Country-years with no event during fieldwork serve as controls.

The identifying assumption is that the exact timing of the first in-fieldwork women directed violence event is plausibly exogenous — not predictable by respondents or driven by pre-existing mobilisation trends. This is probed via the parallel trends check and the diagnostic checks below.

## DiD Setup

```{r did-setup, cache=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(lme4)

# ── Step 1: Fieldwork windows for the exact-date sample ──────────────────────
# DiD requires individual interview dates → use exact_data (N ≈ 57 CY).
fw_windows_did <- exact_data %>%
  distinct(country, year, start_fw, end_fw) %>%
  filter(!is.na(start_fw), !is.na(end_fw))

# ── Step 2: First GBV event per CY during fieldwork ──────────────────────────
# Only CYs where ≥ 1 state-GBV event falls within [start_fw, end_fw].
# The date of the FIRST event is the treatment cutoff.
first_gbv_fw <- fw_windows_did %>%
  left_join(
    acled_gbv_state %>%
      mutate(event_date = as.Date(event_date)) %>%
      select(country, event_date),
    by = "country",
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) %>%
  filter(event_date >= start_fw, event_date <= end_fw) %>%
  group_by(country, year) %>%
  summarise(first_gbv_date = min(event_date), .groups = "drop")

cat("CYs with ≥1 GBV event during fieldwork (treated):", nrow(first_gbv_fw), "\n")
cat("CYs with zero GBV events (controls):             ",
    nrow(fw_windows_did) - nrow(first_gbv_fw), "\n")

# ── Step 3: Build DiD variables at respondent level ──────────────────────────
# gbv_during_fw : 1 if the CY had any GBV event during fieldwork, else 0
# post_event    : 1 if respondent interviewed AFTER first GBV event; always 0
#                 for control CYs (no cutoff date)
did_data <- exact_data %>%
  left_join(first_gbv_fw, by = c("country", "year")) %>%
  mutate(
    gbv_during_fw = as.integer(!is.na(first_gbv_date)),
    post_event    = as.integer(!is.na(first_gbv_date) & date_interview > first_gbv_date)
  )

# ── Step 4: Balance check — pre/post cell sizes within treated CYs ───────────
# CYs with too few pre- or post-event respondents yield unstable estimates.
cat("\nPre / post respondent counts within each treated CY:\n")
did_data %>%
  filter(gbv_during_fw == 1) %>%
  count(country, year, post_event) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = post_event, values_from = n,
              values_fill = 0, names_prefix = "n_") %>%
  print()

# ── Step 5: Retain treated CYs with ≥ 30 pre AND ≥ 30 post respondents ───────
# All control CYs are kept regardless.
# Threshold of 30 is conservative but ensures stable within-cell estimates.
valid_treated_cy <- did_data %>%
  filter(gbv_during_fw == 1) %>%
  count(country, year, post_event) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = post_event, values_from = n,
              values_fill = 0, names_prefix = "n_") %>%
  filter(n_0 >= 30, n_1 >= 30) %>%
  select(country, year)

cat("\nTreated CYs passing balance filter (n_pre ≥ 30 & n_post ≥ 30):\n")
print(valid_treated_cy)

did_data_filtered <- did_data %>%
  filter(
    gbv_during_fw == 0 |
    paste(country, year) %in% paste(valid_treated_cy$country, valid_treated_cy$year)
  )

# ── Step 6: Background violence / protest controls ────────────────────────────
# Window: [start_fw − 365, start_fw) — the 12 months BEFORE fieldwork begins.

# Anchoring at fieldwork START (not fwmid, not interview date) is the most conservative choice for a DiD design:
#   - Completely pre-treatment by construction: no in-fieldwork GBV event can fall inside this window, regardless of when during fieldwork it occurs.
#   - fwmid anchor would be contaminated if the GBV event falls in the first half of fieldwork; interview-date anchor varies by respondent and directly overlaps with the post-event period.
#   - CY-level constant: same value for all respondents in the same CY.
#   - Available for ALL CYs (treated and control alike) — no NA or zero-fill.
#   - 365-day window chosen over 180 days because these are structural ambient controls, not the focal short-term salience measure.

gen_violence_pre <- fw_windows_did %>%
  left_join(
    acled_non_gbv_violence %>%
      mutate(event_date = as.Date(event_date)) %>%
      select(country, event_date),
    by = "country", relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) %>%
  filter(event_date >= (start_fw - 365), event_date < start_fw) %>%
  group_by(country, year) %>%
  summarise(n_gen_violence_pre = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(log_gen_violence_pre_z = as.numeric(scale(log(n_gen_violence_pre + 1))))

gen_protest_pre <- fw_windows_did %>%
  left_join(
    acled_non_fem_protests %>%
      mutate(event_date = as.Date(event_date)) %>%
      select(country, event_date),
    by = "country", relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) %>%
  filter(event_date >= (start_fw - 365), event_date < start_fw) %>%
  group_by(country, year) %>%
  summarise(n_gen_protest_pre = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(log_gen_protest_pre_z = as.numeric(scale(log(n_gen_protest_pre + 1))))

did_data_filtered <- did_data_filtered %>%
  left_join(gen_violence_pre, by = c("country", "year")) %>%
  left_join(gen_protest_pre,  by = c("country", "year")) %>%
  mutate(
    log_gen_violence_pre_z = replace_na(log_gen_violence_pre_z, 0),
    log_gen_protest_pre_z  = replace_na(log_gen_protest_pre_z,  0)
  )

cat("\nFinal DiD sample summary:\n")
cat("  Total respondents    :", nrow(did_data_filtered), "\n")
cat("  Treated — post-event :", sum(did_data_filtered$post_event == 1, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("  Treated — pre-event  :", sum(did_data_filtered$gbv_during_fw == 1 &
                                     did_data_filtered$post_event == 0, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("  Control              :", sum(did_data_filtered$gbv_during_fw == 0, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
```

## DiD Models

```{r did-models, cache=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ── Timing controls ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# days_since_fw_start_z  : respondent's position within the fieldwork window
# fieldwork_days_z       : total length of the fieldwork window
# log_gen_violence_pre_z : general violence in [start_fw − 365, start_fw)
# log_gen_protest_pre_z  : general protest  in [start_fw − 365, start_fw)

# Background controls use a 365-day window ending at fieldwork START — fully
# pre-treatment, CY-level constant, same for treated and control CYs.
# See Step 6 in did-setup for full rationale.
time_did <- paste(
  "fieldwork_days_z + days_since_fw_start_z +",
  "log_gen_violence_pre_z + log_gen_protest_pre_z"
)

# ── Model 1 & 2: DiD baseline ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Does being interviewed after the first in-fieldwork GBV event increase high-risk mobilisation, net of individual and macro controls?
f_did_base <- paste(
  "activism_high_final ~ post_event +",
  ctrl_indiv, "+", ctrl_macro, "+",
  time_did,   "+", re
)

# ── Model 3 & 4: DiD × egalitarianism ────────────────────────────────────────
# Does gender norm context moderate the post-event mobilisation response?
# Key coefficient: post_event:gender_norms_z
# Note: gbv_during_fw is CY-constant and absorbed by (1 | country:year).
f_did_triple <- paste(
  "activism_high_final ~ post_event * gender_norms_z +",
  ctrl_indiv, "+", ctrl_macro, "+",
  time_did,   "+", re
)

# ── Data without Uzbekistan 2022 ──────────────────────────────────────────────
# Uzbekistan is the single most influential treated CY in the baseline model.
# I re-estimate without it to assess sensitivity.
data_no_uzbek <- did_data_filtered %>%
  filter(!(country == "Uzbekistan" & year == 2022))

# ── Estimate all four models ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
m_did_base            <- lmer(as.formula(f_did_base),   data = did_data_filtered, REML = FALSE)
m_did_base_no_uzbek   <- lmer(as.formula(f_did_base),   data = data_no_uzbek,     REML = FALSE)
m_did_triple          <- lmer(as.formula(f_did_triple), data = did_data_filtered, REML = FALSE)
m_did_triple_no_uzbek <- lmer(as.formula(f_did_triple), data = data_no_uzbek,     REML = FALSE)

```

## Parallel Trends Plot

```{r did-parallel-trends, fig.width=10, fig.height=6, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ── Rationale ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# If the parallel trends assumption holds, the Control and Treated-pre-event
# lines should track each other across fieldwork time before the event.
# A divergence in the Treated-post-event line is consistent with a treatment effect.

pt_data <- did_data_filtered %>%
  mutate(
    group = case_when(
      gbv_during_fw == 0 ~ "Control (no GBV during FW)",
      post_event    == 1 ~ "Treated — post-event",
      post_event    == 0 ~ "Treated — pre-event"
    ),
    group = factor(group, levels = c(
      "Control (no GBV during FW)",
      "Treated — pre-event",
      "Treated — post-event"
    ))
  )

pt_colours <- c(
  "Control (no GBV during FW)" = "grey50",
  "Treated — pre-event"        = "#2b8cbe",
  "Treated — post-event"       = "#D94111"
)

ggplot(pt_data,
       aes(x = days_since_fw_start_z, y = activism_high_final,
           colour = group, fill = group)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, linewidth = 0.9, alpha = 0.12) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = pt_colours, name = NULL) +
  scale_fill_manual(values   = pt_colours, name = NULL) +
  labs(
    title    = "Parallel Trends Check",
    subtitle = "Smoothed mean mobilisation over fieldwork; treated CYs split at first GBV event",
    x        = "Days since fieldwork start (z-scored)",
    y        = "High-risk mobilisation"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = "serif", base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title       = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle    = element_text(size = 12, colour = "grey40"),
    axis.title       = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text        = element_text(size = 11)
  )

ggsave("figures/did_parallel_trends.pdf", width = 10, height = 6, device = "pdf")
```

## Parallel Trends: Manual Means by Day

```{r did-parallel-manual, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ── Mean activism by integer day since fieldwork start, per group ─────────────
# Prints a wide table: one row per day, columns = Control / Treated-pre / Treated-post
# Use this to eyeball whether Control and Treated-pre track each other before
# the event — the key visual test of the parallel trends assumption.
# Note: only days with ≥ 5 respondents in a group are shown (noisier cells hidden).

parallel_means <- did_data_filtered %>%
  mutate(
    day   = as.integer(as.numeric(date_interview - start_fw)),
    group = case_when(
      gbv_during_fw == 0 ~ "control",
      post_event    == 1 ~ "treated_post",
      post_event    == 0 ~ "treated_pre"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(day), !is.na(activism_high_final)) %>%
  group_by(day, group) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_activism = round(mean(activism_high_final, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    n             = n(),
    .groups       = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # suppress cells with fewer than 5 obs (too noisy to interpret)
  filter(n >= 5) %>%
  select(-n) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = mean_activism) %>%
  arrange(day) %>%
  rename(
    Day              = day,
    Control          = control,
    `Treated (pre)`  = treated_pre,
    `Treated (post)` = treated_post
  )

print(parallel_means, n = 200)
```

## Diagnostic Checks

```{r did-diagnostics, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ── Check 1: Missing data in key DiD variables ────────────────────────────────
cat("=== Check 1: Missing data ===\n")
did_data_filtered %>%
  summarise(
    n_miss_post_event    = sum(is.na(post_event)),
    n_miss_gbv_during_fw = sum(is.na(gbv_during_fw)),
    n_miss_activism      = sum(is.na(activism_high_final))
  ) %>%
  print()

# ── Check 2: Anticipation effects ─────────────────────────────────────────────
# Did mobilisation start rising in the WEEK BEFORE the event?
# If yes, post_event may capture anticipation rather than reaction.
cat("\n=== Check 2: Anticipation (week before event) ===\n")
did_data_filtered %>%
  mutate(
    anticipation = as.integer(
      gbv_during_fw == 1 &
      date_interview >= first_gbv_date - 7 &
      date_interview <  first_gbv_date
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(anticipation) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            mean_activism = mean(activism_high_final, na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  print()

# ── Check 3: Effect heterogeneity across treated CYs ─────────────────────────
# Which country-years drive the average effect? Flags dependence on outliers.
cat("\n=== Check 3: Effect heterogeneity (treated CYs, top and bottom 3) ===\n")
heterogeneity <- did_data_filtered %>%
  filter(gbv_during_fw == 1) %>%
  group_by(country, year) %>%
  summarise(
    n_pre              = sum(post_event == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_post             = sum(post_event == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_pre_activism  = mean(activism_high_final[post_event == 0], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_post_activism = mean(activism_high_final[post_event == 1], na.rm = TRUE),
    effect             = mean_post_activism - mean_pre_activism,
    .groups            = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(effect)

print(bind_rows(head(heterogeneity, 3), tail(heterogeneity, 3)))

# ── Check 4: Sensitivity to balance threshold ─────────────────────────────────
# How many treated CYs survive at different minimum cell-size thresholds?
cat("\n=== Check 4: Threshold sensitivity ===\n")
for (thr in c(10, 20, 30, 50)) {
  n_cy <- did_data %>%
    filter(gbv_during_fw == 1) %>%
    count(country, year, post_event) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = post_event, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
    filter(`0` >= thr, `1` >= thr) %>%
    nrow()
  cat(sprintf("  Min n ≥ %2d  →  %d treated CYs retained\n", thr, n_cy))
}
```

# Diagnostics

```{r}
# ── ICC: between-CY share of variation in the Gend Rep ratio ─────────────────────
library(lme4)
icc_mod <- lmer(gbv_ratio_exact_roll730_z ~ 1 + (1 | country:year),
                data = cy_r730_exact, REML = TRUE)
vc      <- as.data.frame(VarCorr(icc_mod))
icc_val <- vc$vcov[1] / sum(vc$vcov)
cat("ICC:", round(icc_val, 3), "\n")

# ── Within-CY SD of the Gend Rep ratio (per respondent) ──────────────────────────
within_sd <- cy_r730_exact %>%
  group_by(country, year) %>%
  summarise(
    sd_r180 = sd(gbv_ratio_exact_roll180_z, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_r365 = sd(gbv_ratio_exact_roll365_z, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_r730 = sd(gbv_ratio_exact_roll730_z, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_resp  = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(sd_r730))

print(within_sd, n = Inf)

ggplot(within_sd, aes(x = sd_r180))+
  geom_density()

# ── CYs where NO women-directed event hit any respondent's window ─────────────
# Proxy: if all respondents in a CY have count = 0, no event occurred in-window
# (Requires the raw count variable, not the z-scored one)
cy_gbv_status <- cy_r730_exact %>%
  group_by(country, year) %>%
  summarise(
    max_gbv_r730 = max(gbv_st_exact_roll730, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_nongbv   = max(non_gbv_st_exact_roll730, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_resp       = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    no_women_events  = max_gbv_r730  == 0,
    no_general_viol  = max_nongbv    == 0
  )

cat("Total CYs in cy_r730_exact:", nrow(cy_gbv_status), "\n")
cat("CYs with NO women-directed events (any window):",
    sum(cy_gbv_status$no_women_events, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("CYs with NO general violence (any window):",
    sum(cy_gbv_status$no_general_viol, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

fw_events <- cy_r730_exact %>%
  group_by(country, year) %>%
  summarise(
    # SD of raw counts — not z-scored, so numerator and denominator are separate
    sd_gbv_count    = sd(gbv_st_exact_roll730,     na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_nongbv_count = sd(non_gbv_st_exact_roll730, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_gbv        = mean(gbv_st_exact_roll730,   na.rm = TRUE),
    n_resp          = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    had_gbv_during_fw    = sd_gbv_count    > 0,
    had_nongbv_during_fw = sd_nongbv_count > 0
  )

cat("Total CYs:", nrow(fw_events), "\n")
cat("CYs with GBV events during fieldwork:    ",
    sum(fw_events$had_gbv_during_fw,    na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("CYs with non-GBV events during fieldwork:",
    sum(fw_events$had_nongbv_during_fw, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")

# Detail table: CYs that had GBV during fieldwork
fw_events %>%
  filter(had_gbv_during_fw) %>%
  arrange(desc(sd_gbv_count)) %>%
  select(country, year, sd_gbv_count, sd_nongbv_count, mean_gbv, n_resp) %>%
  print(n = 12)

# Per-CY: interview date range + event count range
fw_check <- cy_r730_exact %>%
  group_by(country, year) %>%
  summarise(
    fw_start    = min(date_interview, na.rm = TRUE),
    fw_end      = max(date_interview, na.rm = TRUE),
    fw_days     = as.numeric(max(date_interview, na.rm = TRUE) -
                             min(date_interview, na.rm = TRUE)),
    min_gbv     = min(gbv_st_exact_roll180, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_gbv     = max(gbv_st_exact_roll180, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_gbv    = mean(gbv_st_exact_roll180, na.rm = TRUE),
    events_during_fw = max_gbv - min_gbv,   # approx: events added to window during fw
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(events_during_fw))

# Focus on the two key cases
fw_check %>% filter(country %in% c("Venezuela", "Uruguay"))

# And the full table for context
print(fw_check, n = Inf)

fw_check <- cy_r730_exact %>%
  group_by(country, year) %>%
  summarise(
    fw_start         = min(date_interview, na.rm = TRUE),
    fw_end           = max(date_interview, na.rm = TRUE),
    fw_days          = as.numeric(max(date_interview, na.rm = TRUE) -
                                  min(date_interview, na.rm = TRUE)),
    min_gbv          = min(gbv_st_exact_roll180, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_gbv          = max(gbv_st_exact_roll180, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_gbv         = mean(gbv_st_exact_roll180, na.rm = TRUE),
    events_during_fw = max_gbv - min_gbv,
    min_nongbv       = min(non_gbv_st_exact_roll180, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_nongbv       = max(non_gbv_st_exact_roll180, na.rm = TRUE),
    nongbv_during_fw = max_nongbv - min_nongbv,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

cat("CYs with GBV during fieldwork (Roll-180):",
    sum(fw_check$events_during_fw > 0), "\n")
cat("CYs with NO GBV during fieldwork (Roll-180):",
    sum(fw_check$events_during_fw == 0), "\n")
cat("CYs with non-GBV violence during fieldwork (Roll-180):",
    sum(fw_check$nongbv_during_fw > 0), "\n")
cat("CYs with NO non-GBV violence during fieldwork (Roll-180):",
    sum(fw_check$nongbv_during_fw == 0), "\n")
```

# Robustness: Interview Privacy (S013B)

This section checks whether the presence of third parties during the WVS interview confounds the main results. S013B was not administered in 18 of 72 country-years (concentrated in African CYs and early waves), so this check runs on the restricted subsample where coverage exists. Results are compared across structural ambient (fwmid) and interview-date-anchored (exact) strategies for all three rolling windows on the common 61-CY sample.

```{r privacy-join, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ── Build privacy lookup from wvs_raw (already in memory) ────────────────────
privacy_lookup <- wvs_raw %>%
  transmute(
    respondent_id     = as.numeric(S007),
    interview_privacy = case_when(
      S013B == 1 ~ 1,
      S013B == 2 ~ 0,
      TRUE       ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

# Patch all analytical datasets in memory
fwmid_data <- fwmid_data %>% left_join(privacy_lookup, by = "respondent_id")
exact_data <- exact_data %>% left_join(privacy_lookup, by = "respondent_id")
cy_r730    <- cy_r730    %>% left_join(privacy_lookup, by = "respondent_id")

cat("interview_privacy distribution in cy_r730:\n")
print(table(cy_r730$interview_privacy, useNA = "always"))
cat("\nCYs with 0% coverage (will be dropped from privacy models):\n")
cy_r730 %>%
  group_by(country, year) %>%
  summarise(pct_valid = mean(!is.na(interview_privacy)), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(pct_valid == 0) %>%
  print()
```

```{r privacy-models, cache=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ── ctrl_indiv extended with interview_privacy ────────────────────────────────
ctrl_indiv_priv <- paste(ctrl_indiv, "+ interview_privacy")

windows <- c("roll180", "roll365", "roll730")

models_priv_fwmid <- list()
models_priv_exact <- list()

for (w in windows) {
  # fwmid
  gv      <- paste0("gbv_ratio_fwmid_", w, "_z")
  gv_w    <- paste0("log_non_gbv_st_fwmid_", w, "_z + I(log_non_gbv_st_fwmid_", w, "_z^2) + log_gen_prot_fwmid_", w, "_z")
  ctrl_cy <- paste(ctrl_macro, "+", gv_w, "+", time_c_fw)
  f4      <- paste("activism_high_final ~", gv, "* gender_norms_z +",
                   ctrl_indiv_priv, "+", ctrl_cy, "+", re)
  m4_vars <- c("activism_high_final",
               all.vars(as.formula(paste("~", gv, "* gender_norms_z +",
                                         ctrl_indiv_priv, "+", ctrl_cy))))
  data_bal <- cy_r730[complete.cases(cy_r730[, intersect(m4_vars, names(cy_r730))]), ]
  models_priv_fwmid[[w]] <- lmer(as.formula(f4), data = data_bal, REML = FALSE)

  # exact
  gv_e    <- paste0("gbv_ratio_exact_", w, "_z")
  gv_w_e  <- paste0("log_non_gbv_st_exact_", w, "_z + I(log_non_gbv_st_exact_", w, "_z^2) + log_gen_prot_exact_", w, "_z")
  ctrl_cy_e <- paste(ctrl_macro, "+", gv_w_e, "+", time_c)
  f4_e    <- paste("activism_high_final ~", gv_e, "* gender_norms_z +",
                   ctrl_indiv_priv, "+", ctrl_cy_e, "+", re)
  m4_vars_e <- c("activism_high_final",
                 all.vars(as.formula(paste("~", gv_e, "* gender_norms_z +",
                                           ctrl_indiv_priv, "+", ctrl_cy_e))))
  data_bal_e <- cy_r730[complete.cases(cy_r730[, intersect(m4_vars_e, names(cy_r730))]), ]
  models_priv_exact[[w]] <- lmer(as.formula(f4_e), data = data_bal_e, REML = FALSE)
}

cat("Privacy-controlled models estimated.\n")
cat("fwmid CYs:", sapply(models_priv_fwmid, function(m) length(unique(model.frame(m)$`country:year` %||% levels(getME(m, "flist")[[1]])))), "\n")
```

```{r privacy-table, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
priv_cm <- c(
  "gbv_ratio_fwmid_roll180_z"                    = "Gend. Repression (Roll-180)",
  "gbv_ratio_fwmid_roll365_z"                    = "Gend. Repression (Roll-365)",
  "gbv_ratio_fwmid_roll730_z"                    = "Gend. Repression (Roll-730)",
  "gbv_ratio_exact_roll180_z"                    = "Gend. Repression (Roll-180)",
  "gbv_ratio_exact_roll365_z"                    = "Gend. Repression (Roll-365)",
  "gbv_ratio_exact_roll730_z"                    = "Gend. Repression (Roll-730)",
  "gender_norms_z"                               = "Egalitarianism (z)",
  "gbv_ratio_fwmid_roll180_z:gender_norms_z"     = "Gend. Repression × Egalitarianism",
  "gbv_ratio_fwmid_roll365_z:gender_norms_z"     = "Gend. Repression × Egalitarianism",
  "gbv_ratio_fwmid_roll730_z:gender_norms_z"     = "Gend. Repression × Egalitarianism",
  "gbv_ratio_exact_roll180_z:gender_norms_z"     = "Gend. Repression × Egalitarianism",
  "gbv_ratio_exact_roll365_z:gender_norms_z"     = "Gend. Repression × Egalitarianism",
  "gbv_ratio_exact_roll730_z:gender_norms_z"     = "Gend. Repression × Egalitarianism",
  "interview_privacy"                            = "Interview Privacy (1=private)"
)

modelsummary(
  list(
    "fwmid R-180" = models_priv_fwmid[["roll180"]],
    "fwmid R-365" = models_priv_fwmid[["roll365"]],
    "fwmid R-730" = models_priv_fwmid[["roll730"]],
    "exact R-180"  = models_priv_exact[["roll180"]],
    "exact R-365"  = models_priv_exact[["roll365"]],
    "exact R-730"  = models_priv_exact[["roll730"]]
  ),
  coef_map = priv_cm,
  stars    = c("+" = .1, "*" = .05, "**" = .01, "***" = .001),
  gof_map  = gof_custom,
  title    = "Robustness: Interview Privacy Control — M4, all windows, restricted sample"
)
```

# Robustness: Individual-Level Egalitarianism

This section checks whether substituting individual-level gender attitudes for country-year mean egalitarianism changes the substantive results. The theoretical expectation is that societal normative context — not individual attitudes — drives the moderation; this check verifies that different things do not happen when the level of aggregation changes. I run it for all three designs (fwmid, exact, DiD) and compare side-by-side with the original CY-mean specifications.

## Setup

```{r indiv-norms-setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ── Create standardised individual-level norms in each analytical dataset ─────
# gender_norms_index_raw = mean(C001_norm, D059_norm) for each respondent
# Standardised globally so scale matches gender_norms_z

fwmid_data        <- fwmid_data        %>% mutate(gender_norms_indiv_z = as.numeric(scale(gender_norms_index_raw)))
exact_data        <- exact_data        %>% mutate(gender_norms_indiv_z = as.numeric(scale(gender_norms_index_raw)))
did_data_filtered <- did_data_filtered %>% mutate(gender_norms_indiv_z = as.numeric(scale(gender_norms_index_raw)))

# ── Correlation: individual vs CY-mean norms ──────────────────────────────────
# Expect moderate positive correlation: individual scores cluster within CYs
# but vary substantially within them too
cat("Correlation — individual vs CY-mean norms:\n")
cat("  fwmid sample: r =",
    round(cor(fwmid_data$gender_norms_indiv_z,
              fwmid_data$gender_norms_z, use = "complete.obs"), 3), "\n")
cat("  exact sample: r =",
    round(cor(exact_data$gender_norms_indiv_z,
              exact_data$gender_norms_z, use = "complete.obs"), 3), "\n")
```

## Models

```{r indiv-norms-models, cache=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ── Structural ambient: fwmid, Roll-180, M4 ───────────────────────────────────
m_indiv_fwmid <- lmer(
  as.formula(paste(
    "activism_high_final ~ gbv_ratio_fwmid_roll180_z * gender_norms_indiv_z +",
    ctrl_indiv, "+", ctrl_macro, "+",
    "log_non_gbv_st_fwmid_roll180_z + I(log_non_gbv_st_fwmid_roll180_z^2) + log_gen_prot_fwmid_roll180_z +",
    time_c_fw, "+", re
  )),
  data = fwmid_data, REML = FALSE
)

# ── Interview-date-anchored: exact, Roll-180, M4 ──────────────────────────────
m_indiv_exact <- lmer(
  as.formula(paste(
    "activism_high_final ~ gbv_ratio_exact_roll180_z * gender_norms_indiv_z +",
    ctrl_indiv, "+", ctrl_macro, "+",
    "log_non_gbv_st_exact_roll180_z + log_gen_prot_exact_roll180_z +",
    time_c, "+", re
  )),
  data = exact_data, REML = FALSE
)

# ── DiD: individual norms as moderator ────────────────────────────────────────
m_did_indiv <- lmer(
  as.formula(paste(
    "activism_high_final ~ post_event * gender_norms_indiv_z +",
    ctrl_indiv, "+", ctrl_macro, "+",
    time_did, "+", re
  )),
  data = did_data_filtered, REML = FALSE
)

m_did_indiv_no_uzbek <- lmer(
  as.formula(paste(
    "activism_high_final ~ post_event * gender_norms_indiv_z +",
    ctrl_indiv, "+", ctrl_macro, "+",
    time_did, "+", re
  )),
  data = did_data_filtered %>% filter(!(country == "Uzbekistan" & year == 2022)),
  REML = FALSE
)

cat("Individual-norms models estimated.\n")
```

## Comparison Table

```{r indiv-norms-table, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ── Side-by-side: CY-mean (original) vs individual norms ─────────────────────
# Columns ordered: fwmid pair | exact pair | DiD pair
indiv_cm <- c(
  "gbv_ratio_fwmid_roll180_z"                      = "Gend Rep ratio fwmid (z)",
  "gbv_ratio_exact_roll180_z"                      = "Gend Rep ratio exact (z)",
  "post_event"                                     = "Post-Event",
  "gender_norms_z"                                 = "Egalitarianism — CY mean (z)",
  "gender_norms_indiv_z"                           = "Egalitarianism — Individual (z)",
  "gbv_ratio_fwmid_roll180_z:gender_norms_z"       = "GBV × Egal. CY",
  "gbv_ratio_fwmid_roll180_z:gender_norms_indiv_z" = "GBV × Egal. Indiv.",
  "gbv_ratio_exact_roll180_z:gender_norms_z"       = "GBV × Egal. CY",
  "gbv_ratio_exact_roll180_z:gender_norms_indiv_z" = "GBV × Egal. Indiv.",
  "post_event:gender_norms_z"                      = "Post-Event × Egal. CY",
  "post_event:gender_norms_indiv_z"                = "Post-Event × Egal. Indiv."
)

modelsummary(
  list(
    "fwmid CY"       = models_fwmid[["activism_high_final_roll180_m4"]],
    "fwmid Indiv."   = m_indiv_fwmid,
    "Exact CY"       = models_exact[["activism_high_final_roll180_m4"]],
    "Exact Indiv."   = m_indiv_exact,
    "DiD CY"         = m_did_triple,
    "DiD Indiv."     = m_did_indiv
  ),
  coef_map = indiv_cm,
  stars = c("+" = .1, "*" = .05, "**" = .01, "***" = .001),
  gof_map  = gof_custom,
  title    = "Individual vs CY-Level Egalitarianism as Moderator — Roll-180, M4"
)
```

# DiD Robustness: Control Group Composition

This section checks whether restricting the DiD control group to country-years that had GBV events *before* fieldwork (rather than all no-event CYs) changes the substantive results — a check that different things do not happen when a more comparable counterfactual is used. Controls with prior GBV share the same conflict dynamics as treated CYs but differ only in event timing relative to fieldwork. I re-estimate the four main DiD models under this restriction and compare side-by-side with the original pooled specification.

```{r did-ctrl-composition, cache=TRUE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(modelsummary)

# ── Step 1: Identify CYs with GBV events in [start_fw − 365, start_fw) ───────
# These are countries where GBV was "present" in the pre-fieldwork context
# but the event happened not to fall inside the fieldwork window.
prior_gbv_cy <- fw_windows_did %>%
  left_join(
    acled_gbv_state %>%
      mutate(event_date = as.Date(event_date)) %>%
      select(country, event_date),
    by = "country", relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) %>%
  filter(event_date >= (start_fw - 365), event_date < start_fw) %>%
  group_by(country, year) %>%
  summarise(n_prior_gbv = n(), .groups = "drop")

cat("CYs with prior GBV (within 365d before FW start):", nrow(prior_gbv_cy), "\n")
cat("  Of which also treated (in-FW GBV):",
    sum(paste(prior_gbv_cy$country, prior_gbv_cy$year) %in%
        paste(valid_treated_cy$country, valid_treated_cy$year)), "\n")
cat("  Available as restricted controls:",
    sum(!paste(prior_gbv_cy$country, prior_gbv_cy$year) %in%
         paste(valid_treated_cy$country, valid_treated_cy$year)), "\n")

# ── Step 2: Build restricted dataset ─────────────────────────────────────────
# Keep: (a) all treated CYs that passed the balance filter
#        (b) control CYs that had GBV in the year before fieldwork
did_data_prior_ctrl <- did_data_filtered %>%
  filter(
    gbv_during_fw == 1 |
    paste(country, year) %in% paste(prior_gbv_cy$country, prior_gbv_cy$year)
  )

cat("\nPooled control sample  — respondents:", nrow(did_data_filtered),
    "| CYs:", n_distinct(paste(did_data_filtered$country, did_data_filtered$year)), "\n")
cat("Prior-GBV control sample — respondents:", nrow(did_data_prior_ctrl),
    "| CYs:", n_distinct(paste(did_data_prior_ctrl$country, did_data_prior_ctrl$year)), "\n")

# ── Step 3: Re-estimate four models with restricted control group ─────────────
data_prior_no_uzbek <- did_data_prior_ctrl %>%
  filter(!(country == "Uzbekistan" & year == 2022))

m_prior_base            <- lmer(as.formula(f_did_base),   data = did_data_prior_ctrl, REML = FALSE)
m_prior_base_no_uzbek   <- lmer(as.formula(f_did_base),   data = data_prior_no_uzbek, REML = FALSE)
m_prior_triple          <- lmer(as.formula(f_did_triple), data = did_data_prior_ctrl, REML = FALSE)
m_prior_triple_no_uzbek <- lmer(as.formula(f_did_triple), data = data_prior_no_uzbek, REML = FALSE)

cat("\nPrior-GBV control models estimated.\n")
```

```{r did-ctrl-table, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ── Comparison table: pooled vs prior-GBV control ────────────────────────────
# Left four columns = original pooled control (all no-event CYs)
# Right four columns = restricted to CYs with prior GBV only
# Key comparison: does Post-Event hold? Does the interaction pattern change?

modelsummary(
  list(
    # Pooled control (original)
    "Base"          = m_did_base,
    "Base (−UZB)"   = m_did_base_no_uzbek,
    "× Egal."       = m_did_triple,
    "× Egal.(−UZB)" = m_did_triple_no_uzbek,
    # Prior-GBV control (restricted)
    "Base†"          = m_prior_base,
    "Base† (−UZB)"   = m_prior_base_no_uzbek,
    "× Egal.†"       = m_prior_triple,
    "× Egal.†(−UZB)" = m_prior_triple_no_uzbek
  ),
  coef_map = did_cm,
  stars = c("+" = .1, "*" = .05, "**" = .01, "***" = .001),
  gof_map  = gof_custom,
  title    = "DiD Control Group Sensitivity: Pooled (columns 1–4) vs Prior-GBV Controls Only (columns 5–8, †)"
)
```
